title: Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at exmox
description_html:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins. 

We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling.

As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x), this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.

If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Own:

  • Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities.

  • Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately.

  • Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.

  • Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle.

  • Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.


What You Bring

  • Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations.

  • Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer.

  • Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.

  • Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself.

  • High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.

  • Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions.

  • Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.

  • Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders.

  • Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.


Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

Short title

Build brand communities on social media


Introduction

You don't just manage social media, you shape how brands show up on it. As a Senior Social Media Manager at Pulse Advertising, you lead multi-platform strategies for global brand accounts, drive creative direction, and set the standard for platform-native excellence. You know what's about to peak on TikTok before it peaks, and you're as strong creatively as you are strategically, ideating concepts in a client workshop and owning their execution the next day. You're a trusted senior partner to clients and a go-to voice internally, someone who takes ownership of outcomes, not just outputs. If you're ready to lead at the intersection of strategy, creativity, and impact, this is your next chapter.


Your tasks

  • You own TikTok-first content strategies for key global brand accounts, defining platform-native formats, content pillars, and creative direction that drive measurable engagement and business results

  • You lead content planning and execution across TikTok, Reels, Stories, and complementary formats, ensuring every channel feels native, intentional, and on-brand

  • You manage social media across multiple brands within a single parent account, adapting global content frameworks for regional markets with a particular focus on DACH

  • You act as a senior client partner, steering projects from briefing to delivery, proactively shaping agendas and challenging briefs that don't align with platform or audience reality

  • You track, synthesise, and present performance data, translating complex analytics into sharp client-ready insights and actionable recommendations

  • You mentor junior and mid-level team members and contribute to pitches and new business proposals, bringing your platform expertise to grow both the team and the account base


Your skills

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on experience in social media management with a clear TikTok focus, including proven results across global or multi-market brand accounts- ideally in consumer goods, home appliances, or lifestyle hardware

  • You think in TikTok: trend cycles, FYP mechanics, algorithm behaviour, and the instinct to know what feels native versus what kills engagement

  • You are comfortable operating within multi-brand account structures and familiar with global-to-local content models, managing competing brand identities across markets without losing quality or speed

  • You are a hands-on creative with the ability to concept campaign ideas and translate them into platform-native formats that resonate with audiences and impress clients

  • You are experienced with Canva, video editing tools, and social analytics platforms and actively use AI tooling to scale your work

  • You are confident leading senior client relationships, communicating platform logic clearly, managing expectations and influencing decisions at stakeholder level.

  • You are fluent in both German and English 


Our Benefits

  • Time to pack your bags for Paris, London, Milan, Hamburg or Berlin: you’re welcome to work abroad from any of our office locations

  • We love to see you grow: our careers coach is on hand for one-to-one coaching sessions and team workshops

  • We work hard and play hard, bringing our global team together to collaborate, learn from one another and celebrate our successes

  • Don’t fancy the office today? Our hybrid remote policy lets you work from home two days a week

  • Keep your commute to a minimum: you’ll find all our offices right in the city centre

  • For motivational high-paws and comforting cuddles, your four-legged friend is absolutely welcome at our offices

description_html:
Senior Product Designer

Didomi is looking for a Senior Product Designer to take end-to-end ownership of design across multiple products within our Privacy and Consent Management Platform. This is a senior IC role reporting directly to the Design Director, acting as design peer-lead within the Product team, supporting seven Product Managers and their engineering teams. Design is currently the one shared resource across the entire product org, and this role is central to how we scale it.

You'll help shape the future of our product, creating experiences that are intuitive, efficient, and user-centric, while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners. You'll get involved early, shaping problems alongside Product and Engineering rather than just executing against requirements handed to you, and take ownership of your workstreams once scope is assigned based on where the business needs it most.

What you'll do

  • Own the process end-to-end. Lead discovery through delivery for your assigned product areas, handing off finalized UX/functional design to our external creative agency for UI polish.
  • Shape decisions upstream. Get involved before requirements are locked, and bring evidence and clear rationale to engineering-first decisions rather than reacting after the fact.
  • Take ownership across ambiguity. Hold multiple complex workstreams and adapt as scope shifts with business priorities.
  • Build the research muscle. Help establish research and usability practices that don't fully exist today, and translate findings into decisions Product and Engineering can act on.
  • Reduce design debt. Flag and help prevent downstream friction from features shipping without a design pass.
  • Prototype fast with AI. Use tools like Figma Make or Claude to turn concepts into high-level, testable prototypes quickly, helping the team validate direction and unblock decisions without waiting on full design cycles for every idea.
  • Foster a strong design culture. Share knowledge, mentor peers, and help improve team processes.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in product/UX design, with real ownership of complex products and a strong portfolio of shipped work.
  • Fluency in Figma or equivalent design/prototyping tools.
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving, engineering-heavy environments with limited day-to-day oversight.
  • Strong interaction and systems thinking. You can untangle complex flows and design for edge cases.
  • Experience building or contributing to a research practice where formal resourcing is limited.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work efficiently with cross-functional teams.
  • Proven experience designing zero-to-one products, new platforms, or defining new product spaces.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (Figma Make, Claude, or similar) to generate high-level prototypes and accelerate concept validation.

Strongly preferred: experience in privacy, compliance, or another highly regulated/technical domain.

We don't expect candidates to meet every point above. If most of this resonates, we'd love to hear from you.

TBC

description_html:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

The role

This is a full-time Collections Administrator role with hybrid working (minimum 3 days per week in the Milton Keynes office).

The role will be responsible for managing delinquent accounts as they flow through the collections strategy. Day-to-day tasks include administration and reconciliation tasks, updating case management systems, reviewing and processing both hard copy and digital correspondence and liaising with third parties. No prior collections or financial services experience is required — we’ll provide full training on regulation, systems and processes; what matters most is the right attitude, judgement and attention to detail.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who has, or is keen to develop, the following:

  • No prior collections or financial services experience necessary — full training will be provided on FCA regulation (including CONC7), DPA requirements and our internal processes

  • Willing to learn about the broad range of debt solutions, e.g. Payment Arrangements, DMPs, IVAs, Trust Deeds, DROs, Breathing Space etc.

  • Good Microsoft Excel skills, or a willingness to quickly get up to speed with VLOOKUP, Pivot tables, linking sheets etc.

  • Strong attention to detail and consistency, with the discipline to follow pre-defined procedures across multiple IT systems

  • A team player who will help as required to deliver tasks within the team SLAs

  • Familiar with KPIs and targets and quality assurance requirements

  • A flexible team member who can adapt quickly to changing requirements and business demands

What you'll be doing

  • Collections administration, managing delinquent accounts as they flow through the collections strategy

  • Reconciliation of customer loans and completing admin work in line with pre-defined procedures

  • Updating case management systems

  • Reviewing and processing hard copy and digital correspondence

  • Liaising with customers and their third party representatives, e.g., Field suppliers, debt collection agencies, insolvency portfolio managers

  • Assessing customer affordability using our industry leading Open Banking software

    What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

  • 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

  • One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership

  • Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

description_html:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

Kraken is the operating system of the future for Utilities. When a utility signs up to use Kraken, they have some big ambitions. They want to; improve customer experience, reduce cost to serve or accelerate growth and innovation. To make this possible at pace, clients need the incredible tech stack that Kraken offers, the ability to improve how they operate and to have a culture that enables them to thrive. 

Clients are increasingly interested in understanding how they can improve not only their customer operations but the business functions, and business units that sit horizontally and vertically to customer operations in retail. 

To enable this Kraken now structures itself across 3 key delivery practice groups. Human Design, Org Design and Tech. 

This role sits within the Human Design Team. 

Purpose of the Human Design Lead

The main purpose of the Human Design Lead is to be the single point of accountability for the successful enablement and implementation of culture / ways of working transformation in our clients. Human Design activities align to Global Practices and include:

  • Human enablement

  • Behavioural transformation

  • Leadership Development Programs

  • Coaching

  • Learning

🚀 What you’ll own:

  • New and existing senior clients’ relationships

    • Actively involved in the end to end cycle of new clients’ pursuits, sales and onboarding

    • Responsible for regional client portfolio (expected approx 4 clients)

    • Point of contact for senior client relationships long term

    • C-suite leadership coaching and enablement 

  • Kick-start Human Design discussion with clients

    • Initial sprint setup including leading activities such as

      1. Line of Sight

      2. Culture survey

      3. Exec LDP

    • Liaise with Human Design Global Practice Leads to influence and bring best practice into programs

    • Lead top-down cultural transformation, working with the C-suite and exec layer in organisations

    • Senior cover for Human Design activities throughout migration including ongoing risk monitoring and escalation

  • Cultural stewardship

    • Embody the Kraken ways of working and support the delivery team to do the same (and ensure a consistent experience across the portfolio)

    • Act as the bridge between new clients and best practice success stories

🧠 What you bring to the party:

  • In depth knowledge and expertise in all facets of Human Design necessary to enable transformation (including cultural transformation, leadership development, coaching, learning) 

  • Experience in leading portfolios of major program transformations across different geographies

  • Track record of trust-based partnerships with C-suite and executives

  • Excellent communication skills at storytelling level across different seniorities and cultures

  • Excellent facilitation skills

  • Experience in navigating ambiguity and complexity 

  • Clear understanding of the connection between human, organisation and technology in the context of tech-enabled transformations 

  • Experience of working within the Energy, Utilities and Telco industries is highly desirable 

  • In depth knowledge of leadership and organisation behavioral best practices including concepts such as 

    • Psychological safety

    • Empowerment 

    • Growth mindset 

    • Agile leadership 

    • High performing team

What we’re looking for

  • A systems thinker who is human-led based in Paris, France 

  • We are a kind, friendly, human organisation.

  • Deep understanding of adult learning, behaviour change and organisational psychology.

  • A world-class and experienced leadership development expert.

  • A storyteller who deeply understands the art of facilitation 

  • Proven credibility working with senior leaders and executives.

  • Experience building or scaling leadership or learning practices in complex environments.

  • Calm, confident and playful presence - able to challenge with empathy and clarity.

title: Senior Software Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Runa
description_html:
Runa is pioneering a first-of-its-kind payment rail that enables the seamless, global money movement at scale. Legacy banking and payment infrastructure struggles to support the demands of today's low-volume, high-velocity payouts, leading to inefficiencies in global payouts. Businesses worldwide send over $20 trillion annually in rewards, remittances, and disbursements often incurring costs of up to 50% per transaction and subjecting recipients to lengthy delays.

Runa transforms this landscape by providing a new digital payments infrastructure that empowers businesses to send digital money instantly and cost-free to anyone, anywhere. The Runa API empowers thousands of businesses to make payments to 5 billion+ consumers in 190+ countries instantly to cards, wallets, bank accounts and gift cards. Leading companies such as Sodexo, TopCashback, Perkbox, Sweatcoin, Coinbase, and Globetopper rely on Runa to facilitate instant, flexible global payouts to tens of millions of consumers.

 

The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for architecting, implementing and deploying software services from end to end. You’ll produce clean, scalable, and reusable code to build products which will have a big impact on our customers.

You will have the opportunity to work with a modern stack and serverless cloud infrastructure whilst guiding and mentoring more junior engineers in the team.

 

Our Tech

We have Python, TypeScript, and Javascript services running mostly on Lambda functions. We use Step Functions extensively to orchestrate our workflows. Our persistence layer is largely Aurora (Postgres), DynamoDB, MemoryDB (Redis), and Timestream.

However, we understand the dynamic nature of technology and recognize that skills in any programming language is a valuable asset, which is why we are open to engineers from any programming background.

 

What Excites You

  • Contributing towards the design, delivery and deployment of large scale, complex projects which are used heavily by thousands of people with high throughput.

  • Using modern technology like AWS serverless infrastructure and events driven microservice architecture

  • Mentoring more junior members of the team to help support their growth and development and help scale the team by leading on technical interviews.

  • Being a subject matter expert on technology and domain-specific problems, and taking ownership of software services from end to end.

  • Improving responsiveness and overall performance of our web services.

What Excites Us

  • Solid experience as a Software Engineer architecting and developing new services and features from end to end.

  • The ability to take ownership of design and architecture of large scale systems and developing API heavy software solutions without the need for guidance.

  • A passion for promoting software engineering best practice, guiding and mentoring more junior engineers to deliver clean, scalable, and reusable code.

  • Proactively contributing to the continual improvement of our engineering processes

Even if you do not meet all of the above requirements but still think you would be a good fit for the role we would still encourage you to apply.

 

What’s in it for you

🏢 We have a hybrid structure with the requirement of 3 days a week at our London Office (Shoreditch)

📚£1,000 annual L&D allowance to invest in mastering your craft, including accredited studies. Plus 5 L&D days per year

🌴 25 days holiday + public holidays

🔋 Runa Reset Days - Runa closes on the first Friday of each quarter for a well-deserved, Reset Day

☀️ Summer Hours - In the month of August, we log off at 3pm on Fridays.

🗺️ Work from anywhere for up to 45 calendar days a year

🚀 Participation in the Employee Options pool giving you ownership in Runa

🚑 Private Medical + Dental Health Insurance with Bupa

👶 Enhanced parental leave for all new parents, up to 16 weeks full pay

💷 We are currently working towards salary transparency however we are not there just yet so our talent team will discuss this during the initial call to ensure that the right expectations are given.

 

The Interview Process

  1. Call with Talent Lead ☎️

  2. System Design Interview 🛠️

  3. Coding Interview 💻

  4. Values Interview 🌟

 

Want to learn more about life at Runa and our hiring process? Visit our Candidate Hub: https://runahq.notion.site/runa-candidate-hub

 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are committed to providing a hiring and working experience in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Chief Financial Officer (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at deskbird Careers
description_html:
Your mission

deskbird is one of Europe's fastest-growing workplace-management platforms – a SaaS success story serving hundreds of enterprise customers and building the operating system for the workplace of the future, well past €10M ARR and scaling with an efficiency-driven playbook. In 2025 we closed a funding round led by Octopus Ventures, with co-investments from NEVA SGR (Intesa Sanpaolo Bank) and AVP, and participation from Alstin Capital, session, and Portfolion.


We're hiring a Chief Financial Officer (all genders) to be a true co-pilot to the management team. This is not just a back-office finance role. You will sit in board meetings from day one, own the equity story, lead our future financing rounds and capital markets strategy, and run an AI-first operations function that becomes a case study in how lean a modern finance organization can be.


You'll join a small, talented, highly ambitious executive team – and the equity package is designed so that when we win, you win meaningfully.


If you are passionate about creating enterprise value, scaling finance organizations, and owning the story you used to analyze – this is that seat.



In this role you will

  1. The equity story and funding readiness. You will keep deskbird in the best possible shape for whatever comes next - future financing rounds, strategic options, and long-term value creation. Narrative, metrics, data room, diligence readiness: always current, always credible. When we choose to run a process, you will lead it, working directly with the founders and board.

  2. The path to profitability. You’ll own the plan that takes us to sustainable positive cash flows profitability without sacrificing growth: driver-based planning, disciplined capital allocation, and a sharp view on where every franc and euro works hardest.

  3. An AI-first finance & operations function. We want a hands-on operator on the edge of AI development who automates before hiring, works in the models and tools personally, and proves that a lean, AI-augmented team can outperform a traditional org several times its size. We don’t want a CFO who builds a 20-person department.

  4. Commercial intelligence for GTM and Product. You’ll drive the insights that tell us where to invest: which segments, motions, and product bets deliver the strongest combined growth and efficiency profile. Finance at deskbird is a value driver in pricing, packaging, NRR economics, and unit-economics decisions - not just a scorekeeper.

  5. International structure and tax efficiency. You’ll own our multi-entity group structure across Europe, introduce transfer pricing, and ensure we operate in a tax-efficient, fully compliant setup as we scale internationally.

  6. The cap table and investor-grade financials. You’ll keep our cap table and VSOP clean, well-modeled, and always ready for the next financing round, and bring our accounting to the  standard any institutional investor expects - SaaS revenue recognition (local GAAP) done right, smooth statutory audits, and, where a future process demands it, conversion to the relevant GAAP.

  7. Board and investor relations. You’ll run the reporting rhythm, build trust with our existing investors, and represent deskbird credibly to future ones - from day one, alongside the founders.

  8. Cash, risk, and the operational backbone. Treasury, FX, and runway discipline, scenario planning, audit readiness, and oversight of legal, procurement, and insurance.



What you need to be successful

Must-haves

  • A transaction-shaped career: ideally PE, M&A or investment banking, followed by operating experience in a scaling company - you’ve seen deals from the inside and know what investors actually sign up for. (Exceptional candidates from transaction advisory (e.g. Big4) or top-tier strategy consulting with strong deal exposure will also be considered.)
  • Deep fluency in finance processes and B2B SaaS mechanics: ARR/NRR, cohort economics, CAC payback, Rule of 40, the ARR-to-cash bridge.
  • Experience at our scale and complexity (>€10M ARR, ~100+ employees) - and ideally, you’ve already seen what comes next (>€25M ARR), so you know what to build now and what to deliberately skip.
  • Fundraising and/or liquidity event exposure, ideally where the story was efficient, profitable growth rather than growth at all costs.
  • A builder’s ego profile: you measure yourself by enterprise value created per person on your team, not by headcount or budget owned. You’re hands-on and want to stay that way.
  • Genuine excitement about AI-native ways of working - you’re already using these tools daily and want to push further.
  • Based in or willing to work from one of our hubs - Zurich, Berlin, Munich, or London (remote within Europe is possible for an outstanding candidate, but hub-based is our strong preference given the closeness to founders and board). Full working proficiency in English; German is strongly preferred.
Nice to have
  • Experience owning or partnering closely with People & Culture.
  • Multi-entity European operations: Swiss/EU accounting, VAT, transfer pricing, cross-border payroll.
  • Venture debt, structured financing, or buy-side M&A experience.


What’s in it for you?


  • A rare stage - big enough to matter (>€10M ARR, enterprise customers, proven playbook), small enough that your fingerprints will be on everything.
  • Meaningful equity upside - a package built for a founder-like profile in a capital-efficient business, where the value you help create is value you share in.
  • A real seat at the table - board meetings from day one, direct partnership with the founders, and full ownership of your domain.
  • An AI-first culture - the freedom (and expectation) to build the most modern finance function in European SaaS.
  • A high-talent, low-ego executive team that moves fast and debates openly.

title: Customer Success Consultant - Retail Media
description_html:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

Customer Success Consultant - Mirakl Ads (Munich)

About the role

Launched three years ago, Mirakl Ads is Mirakl's global Retail Media technology, empowering eCommerce and Marketplace operators to run successful and profitable Retail Media programs. Now entering a new phase of scale, Mirakl Ads is expanding its client base, developing its media offering, and accelerating its impact across key markets worldwide.

As an Experienced Customer Success Consultant for Mirakl Ads, reporting to the Director of Customer Success, your primary mission is to support Mirakl Ads clients in launching and growing their advertising revenues - from strategy design to day-to-day performance optimization. The ideal candidate is a driven, curious and client-obsessed professional, who thrives in complex, fast-moving environments and brings the energy and structure needed to turn ambition into results.

 

What you will do at Mirakl

The Experienced Customer Success Consultant will have a strong impact on Mirakl Ads growth, managing a portfolio of key clients across all stages of their journey.

  • Lead clients from strategy to implementation: define their Retail Media vision and Mirakl Ads roadmap, design the right organizational setup, co-build a sharp commercial action plan with the right KPIs, and drive execution - ensuring a successful and lasting integration of Retail Media into their business, from first workshops through go-live and beyond
  • Deliver strategic recommendations at business reviews, presenting to client teams and C-levels, sharing market insights and case studies to inspire performance and long-term growth
  • Design and implement the right KPI frameworks to monitor clients' advertising network performance and continuously identify growth levers
  • Support clients in the day-to-day optimization of their Mirakl Ads use (placements, campaign configuration, etc.), ensuring platform adoption and maximizing advertising revenues
  • Lead tailored workshops and training sessions to ensure optimal onboarding and sustained platform mastery over time

 

As part of a growing and structured team, you will also:

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement and industrialization of Customer Success processes and tooling, ensuring scalable and efficient operations as the Mirakl Ads client base grows. Collaborate with BI teams to analyze client activity and monitor advertising network performance
  • Leverage AI tools and capabilities to enhance the way we deliver value to clients and scale our operations - from automating reporting and insights generation to accelerating strategic recommendations and improving the overall client experience
  • Act internally as the voice of the Publisher, providing Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams with actionable insights on how Mirakl Ads fits and solves client needs at scale
  • Stay ahead of market trends and competitive dynamics in the Retail Media industry, translating intelligence into strategic recommendations for clients and internal teams
  • Contribute your vision in meetings with adtech partners to strengthen Mirakl's positioning in the adtech value chain and support the growth of our global Advertising Services initiative

 

What Mirakl is looking for

  • Master's Degree in Business or Engineering
  • 3+ years of experience in retail media, the eCommerce industry, or in a consulting firm with strong exposure to digital advertising and/or marketplace ecosystems
  • Solid knowledge of eCommerce, marketplace, and online advertising, with a strong understanding of adtech value chains
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Strong client-facing and project management skills
  • Highly business-driven with strong analytical skills, thriving in dynamic environments
  • Someone eager to thrive in a scaling business environment, contributing to the continuous improvement of the Mirakl Ads Customer Success practice
  • Fluency in English is a must-have; German and/or French is a strong asset, given our key markets.
  • Self-motivated and energetic, with experience managing multiple internal stakeholders to deliver commercial goals
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Willingness to travel internationally

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

description_html:
YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager, you take ownership of the entire hiring lifecycle across multiple business functions. You partner closely with hiring managers and senior leadership to attract exceptional talent, improve hiring quality, and build scalable recruiting processes that support long-term business growth.

You combine strong recruiting expertise with a strategic mindset, using data, market insights, and stakeholder management to continuously optimize how hiring decisions are made. Beyond filling positions, you help shape the overall Talent Acquisition function by introducing better structures, improving candidate experience, and strengthening our employer brand.

This is a highly visible role for someone who enjoys operating hands-on while building the recruiting foundations of a fast-growing organization.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead end-to-end recruitment across technical, product, commercial, and business functions, managing the full hiring process from kick-off to offer acceptance.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring strategies, challenge role requirements, and support workforce planning.

  • Design, implement, and continuously improve recruiting processes, including intake meetings, interview structures, scorecards, feedback quality, and hiring governance.

  • Develop proactive sourcing strategies across different talent markets, adapting your approach for technical, commercial, and go-to-market roles.

  • Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines through direct sourcing, networking, referrals, and market mapping.

  • Use recruiting data and market insights to identify bottlenecks, improve hiring performance, and provide transparent reporting on key recruiting metrics.

  • Create dashboards and reporting structures covering pipeline health, conversion rates, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and overall hiring performance.

  • Manage and challenge external recruiting partners, ensuring high-quality delivery, clear expectations, and efficient collaboration.

  • Drive employer branding initiatives by improving candidate communication, supporting hiring managers, strengthening social media presence, and enhancing the overall candidate experience.

  • Contribute to the continuous development of the Talent Acquisition function by introducing scalable structures, automation opportunities, and best practices.

WHO YOU ARE

We welcome different career paths, including:

  • 6+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruiting, or Executive Search within fast-growing technology, SaaS, e-commerce, marketplace, or digital businesses.

  • Strong experience recruiting technical profiles, combined with the ability to successfully hire commercial, sales, marketing, and other business functions.

  • Proven experience managing full-cycle recruitment independently across multiple seniority levels.

  • Experience building or significantly improving recruiting processes, hiring frameworks, dashboards, and operational recruiting structures.

  • Strong sourcing capabilities with confidence engaging passive candidates across competitive talent markets.

  • Data-driven mindset with experience using recruiting metrics to improve hiring quality, stakeholder decisions, and overall process efficiency.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the confidence to advise, influence, and constructively challenge senior leaders.

  • Experience working with external recruiting agencies, executive search partners, or freelance recruiters.

  • Strong interest in employer branding and candidate experience, with the ability to strengthen an organization's visibility in the talent market.

  • Highly structured, proactive, and hands-on working style with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

  • Comfortable working in dynamic, fast-changing environments where building structure is just as important as executing day-to-day recruiting.

  • Fluent in both German and English.

title: Head of Customer Experience
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at comstruct ICT
description_html:
The mission:

comstruct is building the agentic workforce for European construction. Our agents turn paper delivery notes, fragmented invoices and offline supplier decisions into structured, real-time data and live decisions, embedded inside the largest contractors in Europe and the US. To accelerate this journey, we secured a €12.5M seed financing round from 20VC and Google Ventures, along with top European investors.

 
 

About the role 🦺

As our Head of Customer Experience you own the entire post-sales journey of our customers. You lead a team that covers everything from Solution Engineering and POV Implementation through Rollout and Adoption to Expansion and Support. Your mission: flawless rollouts and a customer experience that makes comstruct the operating system of every construction site.

 

What you will be building 🏗️

  • Build and lead the CX org: You hire, develop and coach the team across the entire customer experience journey. From scoping ERP architectures in Solution Engineering to resolving requests in Support. You set the structure, the standards and the pace.

  • Make technical rollouts a machine: POVs, supplier integrations, on-site onboardings and multi-site rollouts - you turn what's currently craftsmanship into a scalable system that gets customers to value in weeks, not quarters.

  • Own the post-sales P&L: You tie customer health to ARR, run strategic QBRs with enterprise decision makers and build the engine that surfaces qualified expansion signals before Sales ever gets involved.

  • Shape the product from the field: You sit in Engineering and Product sprint meetings, drive roadmap prioritization from customer signals and make sure what gets built is what moves accounts forward.

     

What we're looking for ✨

  • You bring 3-5 years of experience in Solution Engineering, Implementation, Value Engineering or Customer Success in enterprise or mid-market environments with high implementation complexity. Structuring POV execution and scoping complex technical implementations across multiple stakeholders is your core, not a secondary skill.

  • You have led a team for at least 1-2 years, hiring and developing ICs, in an environment where the playbook didn't exist until you wrote it.

  • You don't need to code, but you can read and map an ERP integration, assess what's feasible and push back in a room full of engineers.

  • You are eager to learn the product from scratch and understand it inside out. You drive roadmap prioritization from the field and connect customer feedback to what actually gets built.

  • You have carried commercial ownership in a previous implementation or GTM role. You've qualified upsell, defended pricing and driven expansion.

  • You handle multi-layered enterprise accounts, tough stakeholder conversations and direct feedback without losing composure.

  • You speak German on a native level and are fluent in English.

Nice to have: Construction Tech, Supply Chain or Logistics SaaS experience; hands-on building of features or integrations; early-stage startup experience (<50 employees) where you built processes from scratch.

 

Why join comstruct? 🛠️

Construction is one of the largest and least digitized industries in the world. We're building its digital future. Founded in March 2022, we've raised a €12.5M seed round from 20VC, Google Ventures and top European investors and nine of Switzerland's ten largest contractors already run on comstruct. That's the foundation. The category-defining company gets built now - together with you!

 

What we offer

  • Real ownership, twice over: Equity options on top of a competitive salary and the freedom to own your work and build things from the ground up, not execute someone else's plan.

  • Learn from the best: Direct mentoring from our Co-founder & CEO Henric Meinhardt, plus access to engineering mentors through our network with Google Ventures and 20VC.

  • Build at the frontier: Early access to the latest LLMs and SDKs, any AI productivity tools you need and top-notch hardware.

  • Invest in yourself: A dedicated development budget for certificates, conferences and everything that makes you grow with the company.

  • Feel at home: Relocation support for your move to Munich, daily dinner options with the team, Wellpass subscription and yearly offsites - the last ones took us to Mallorca and Italy.

What you’ll do:

Join comstruct’s Go to Market team and help shape how we bring innovation to one of the world’s largest industries, construction. As a GTM Intern, you’ll be at the heart of our sales engine, turning data, creativity and persistence into real customer impact.

As a company, we value in-person collaboration and expect employees to work from our Munich office at least 4 days a week.

What you will be building 🏗️

  • Cultivate and nurture relationships with B2B prospects from the construction industry by proactively reaching out to generate interest and schedule discovery calls

  • Utilize multiple channels (LinkedIn, email, phone) to identify potential customers, build outreach campaigns and create engagement with key decision-makers

  • Support comstruct’s Go-to-Market initiatives by researching new customer segments, analyzing target markets and helping to refine our sales strategy

  • Collaborate with the GTM team to track results, improve CRM data quality and optimize our lead generation processes

  • Stay informed about industry trends, competitors and digitalization initiatives within the construction space

What you need to succeed ✨

  • Passion for B2B software sales and a strong interest in startups, SaaS and digital transformation

  • Proactive and curious mindset, eager to learn how Go-to-Market and Sales strategies work in fast-scaling companies

  • Analytical and structured working style, combined with strong attention to detail

  • Excellent communication skills in German (C2 required) and English. You enjoy connecting with people and explaining complex topics simply

  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g. HubSpot or Pipedrive), LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Clay is a plus, but not required

  • Team-oriented attitude – you’re motivated to take ownership and contribute to a growing organization

Why us 🪴

To build the technical foundation of such an important industry, we rely on an outstanding team of A-players across all domains. Working together with humble, pragmatic, and output-oriented people who actively pursue their visions guarantees a steep personal as well as professional learning curve.

  • Your sandbox: try things, break things, learn, and level up

  • Freedom to take over responsibility and to shape your own role/career

  • Great leaders invest in their people’s growth while growing alongside the company

  • Individual Development Budgets e.g., for certificates, conferences, or books

  • Take part in our growth! We offer equity options so you share directly in the value you help create

  • Free drinks, snacks and daily optional dinners in the office

  • Regular Team Events, Wellpass subscription, workations, offsites

  • And it doesn’t end here: great tech gear, referral rewards, and yes - dogs are welcome at the office! 🐶

About comstruct

comstruct is a young construction tech startup founded in 2022. With a team of four co-founders from diverse backgrounds, we are building the data layer for the construction industry. We recently secured a €12.5M seed financing round from prestigious VCs, including 20VC and Google Ventures, along with top European investors. We already serve nine of Switzerland's ten largest contractors as customers, improving the lives of thousands of people in the industry.

Together with YOU, we aim to build a great, diverse team and become the world's leading construction-tech company propelling one of the least digitized industries to the forefront of innovation!

Hunt the Market

Market Development

  • You constantly want to raise the bar, are eager to learn and value feedback

Expert Operator: Du hast 15 Projekte pro Woche gleichzeitig im Blick – und weißt bei jedem, wo es steht, was als nächstes passieren muss und wo Gefahr droht. Prozesse und Prioritäten sind deine Werkzeuge, um auch bei hohem Volumen handlungsfähig zu bleiben.

ZEAL Network SE ist eine dynamische, international tätige Unternehmensgruppe, die seit über 20 Jahren spannende und innovative Lotterieerlebnisse schafft.     • Erfahrung mit Projektmanagement-Tools in Creative-Workflows

  • Ein talentiertes Team aus ambitionierten, gleichgesinnten Kolleg*innen, in dem dein Wissen und deine Ideen wirklich etwas bewegen.

title: Robot Learning Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Rohlik
description_html:
Why this role is exciting

Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows.

We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match.

We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job.

You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them.

What you will own and deliver

  • The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong.

  • Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap.

  • The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows.

  • The first training runs. Once hours bank, you post-train open robot-learning models on our data and run the first task evaluations.

  • Judgment before spend. The field moves monthly. You read what is published, reproduce the claims we depend on, and steer our capture before the money is spent, not after.

The scope

This is a seat on a small, newly created team: an operations lead who runs capture on the floor, a data engineer who owns the pipeline, and you: the machine-learning voice in the room. This is not a research-scientist role, and no publication record is required. The job is to make a corpus trainable and to train the first policies on it.

What we are looking for

  • PyTorch, and computer vision with real 3D geometry. Camera calibration, pose estimation, SLAM fundamentals. You have debugged an extrinsic calibration at least once in your life and know why it drifted.

  • You can read a paper and reproduce it. Our pipeline is assembled from published work, and your job is knowing which claims survive contact with a chilled warehouse hall.

  • You know what policies train on. Familiar with the current robot-learning stack and policy classes well enough to know what the training side will demand of the data before the data exists.

  • Dataset instincts. You have trained on data you collected yourself, and you know the failure modes that only show up at training tim..

  • Comfortable as the only ML voice. You make the call, write it down, and revisit it when the pilot data says otherwise.

  • AI is how work gets done here. Our engineers use Claude Code and Devin daily, and we expect you to direct agents for the unglamorous parts — harness code, data plumbing, reproduction scripts — while keeping the quality bar exactly where it was.

  • Particularly relevant. Hand-pose estimation or egocentric video in production; multi-camera rigs and time sync; experience post-training robot-learning models; ROS 2.

What success looks like in 90 days

Rohlik is one of Europe’s leading online grocery businesses, operating in the Czech Republic, Hungary, Austria, Germany and Romania through Rohlik.cz, Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at, Knuspr.de and Sezamo.ro.

By owning our end-to-end operations and developing our technology in-house, we are able to deliver a customer experience built around freshness, speed, reliability and a broad assortment of both local and international products.

As we continue to scale, we are looking for a Senior Vice President Operations to lead the next stage of our operational development across Europe.

This is one of the most critical executive roles in the company, combining full ownership of the performance, scalability and continuous improvement of Rohlik’s end-to-end operations across all markets with a highly visible, hands-on mandate that requires moving confidently between group strategy and detailed operational performance.

 

Why this role is exciting

  • You will lead the operational agenda of one of Europe’s most ambitious and complex e-grocery businesses.

  • You will have a direct impact on growth, profitability and customer experience across multiple countries.

  • You will shape how our operations scale, from fulfillment and supply chain to last-mile delivery and customer operations.

  • You will lead both operational performance and long-term transformation, including automation, technology and new-market readiness.

  • You will influence the daily experience of millions of customers and thousands of employees across Europe.

 

What you will own and deliver

You will take full ownership of Rohlik’s group-wide operations strategy and execution, ensuring that our operating model delivers consistent performance today while remaining ready for future growth.

Your scope will include:

  • Leading end-to-end operations across all markets

  • Aligning and leading local COOs to deliver consistently high standards

  • Driving performance across fulfillment centres, supply chain, warehousing, last-mile delivery and customer operations

  • Owning group-wide operational P&L performance and driving year-on-year improvements in productivity, efficiency and cost

  • Establishing clear group-wide standards across safety, quality, reliability, customer satisfaction and operational performance

  • Ensuring consistent execution and aligned KPIs across all markets

  • Building scalable operations that support growth without compromising customer experience

  • Ensuring new markets, fulfillment centres and operational capabilities launch on time and are ready to scale

  • Partnering with the CEO Retail and the Executive Leadership Team on company strategy, growth and expansion

  • Providing operational input into financial planning, budgeting and investment decisions

  • Leading major transformation, automation and continuous-improvement initiatives

  • Strengthening business continuity, risk management and regulatory compliance

  • Building a culture of accountability, innovation, ownership and customer obsession

  • Developing and inspiring senior operational leaders across countries and functions

Success in this role will be visible through stronger operational P&L performance, consistent execution across markets, measurable improvements in productivity and cost, high levels of safety and customer satisfaction, and an operating model that can scale with Rohlik’s continued growth.

 

What we are looking for

title: Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Rohlik
description_html:
Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale.

 

Role Overview

This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs.

You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number.

The role is deliberately hands on. You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you.

 

Why this role is exciting

  • You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck.

  • You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth — including the journey toward IPO readiness.

  • You’ll have access to a top-notch AI-first tech stack and the freedom to use it pragmatically.

  • You’ll work directly with the Group CFO, with fast decisions and no corporate red tape.

  • Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately — not parked in a roadmap waiting for HQ approval.

  • You’ll lead a small team, but this is not a “manager from a distance” role. It’s highly hands-on, high-impact, and built for someone who wants to make things move fast.

 

What we expect from you

  • Own the AI and automation agenda across finance, from strategy through delivery to measured impact.

  • Lead process redesign the right way: map and understand the as-is, then design an agentic-first to-be rather than automating the old steps.

  • Lead complex cross-functional programmes across Finance, Tech and Operations, driving delivery through stakeholders and teams beyond your direct reporting line.

  • Bring the live programme to its targets, with a clear owner, baseline and deadline behind every workstream.

  • Redesign core finance processes around AI and agents, starting with close, reporting and forecasting.

  • Build and ship yourself when it is faster, using AI assisted tools to create agents and connect systems such as NetSuite, Rossum and n8n.

  • Lead and grow the team (three today) and raise AI fluency across finance and the SSC so the business can use what you build.

  • Track what matters and report it straight: automation rate, close time, cash allocation speed, cost and effort taken out.

  • Roll out across our five markets, balancing local reality against one Group standard.

 

What we look for

You have probably spent time in strategy consulting or in a transformation role, and you are now genuinely excited by what AI can do. You are a sharp generalist who can walk into a messy process, find the real problem, and fix it. You are as comfortable in a CFO pre-read as you are in the AI first tool building the thing.

  • A track record of leading transformation or automation programmes that actually delivered. A consulting, operations or generalist operator background all fit.

  • Strong understanding of finance processes, ideally gained through finance transformation, operating model redesign or automation programmes.

  • Hands on with AI. You can build agents and integrate APIs with AI assistance. You are not a software engineer and you do not need to be, but the tooling does not scare you.

  • You set baselines, name owners, hit deadlines, and say so early when something slips.

  • You can lead a small team and still do the work yourself.

  • You prioritise by impact and move fast. Better done than perfect.

  • You bring finance, tech and operations along with you.

  • Fluent in English. other languages will be an advantage.

  • Regular travel to Prague HQ required (min. 4 days per month)

What we offer

  • Unlimited vacation days to support a healthy work-life balance

  • Monthly vouchers: €45 tax-free via become.1

  • €20 monthly internet allowance

  • Knuspr Xtra account and 10% discount in the form of Knuspr credits / cashback

  • Great discounts through Corporate Benefits – fitness, travel, tickets, shopping and much more

  • Real growth: we’re not a traditional corporate.

  • Knuspr vibe: an international team, flat hierarchy, and a first-name culture where mistakes are seen as opportunities to learn

title: Data & Analytics Engineer (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Statista
description_html:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your role

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services in Python that power our data access and distribution layer

  • Build and operate automated build, test, and deployment pipelines following CI/CD and GitOps practices, running on AWS and Kubernetes

  • Design and maintain data models and schemas (Avro, SQL) for our data pipelines and services, and publish them to downstream consumers via our Kafka-based distribution platform and schema registry

  • Build access-layer data models in our analytics environment (e.g., Snowflake) so applications can work with the data directly, including via API

  • Act as the coordination interface between the Data and Tech divisions, aligning priorities, schemas, and timelines across upstream and downstream teams

Your profile

  • 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role.

  • Strong SQL skills and solid experience in data modeling (e.g., dimensional modeling, star schemas).

  • Hands-on experience with event streaming and message distribution, ideally Kafka, including schema management with the Kafka schema registry (Avro, Protobuf, or JSON Schema).

  • Experience designing data contracts and schemas between upstream producers and downstream consumers.

  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and modern data stack tools (e.g., dbt, CI/CD).

  • Openness to AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., Claude Code or similar).

  • Comfort working at the boundary of streaming/operational data and analytical data models, and building access layers that serve applications via API.

  • Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused and structured working style.

  • Interest in data governance, standards, and scalable data architecture.

  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus), with both technical and business stakeholders, combined with a solid understanding of business requirements and contexts.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

Statista Healthcare is a vertical business unit of Statista, focused on making healthcare quality transparent, measurable, and comparable across countries, care settings, and specialties. We work with leading healthcare stakeholders worldwide to support data-driven quality measurement and transformation by combining in-depth analytical expertise with scalable technology and communication power.

Our offerings span international rankings, ratings, benchmarking studies, and customized consulting projects. Our global healthcare rankings and hospital ratings are published in collaboration with our trusted media partner Newsweek, enabling high visibility and credibility across markets.

We help healthcare organizations define relevant key performance indicators, validate and harmonize data structures, and translate insights into actionable strategies. At the heart of our approach is a data driven understanding of healthcare quality, grounded in robust methodologies, global comparability, and stakeholder trust.

In our consulting projects, we support healthcare providers and systems in developing tailored KPI frameworks, standardizing and validating data processes, and deriving actionable insights that enable measurable improvements in patient care and system-level performance. We combine structured methodologies with hands-on delivery to unlock the full value of healthcare quality data.

Your Role
As Data Science Consultant Statista Healthcare, you will join our international team of data professionals, supporting the analytical backbone of Statista’s healthcare activities.

Your work will focus on the collection, processing, and analysis of healthcare data that power our Rankings, Ratings, and Benchmarking projects, as well as the development of new, data-driven products.

In Benchmarking and custom quality development projects with healthcare providers and other stakeholders you will be part of an interdisciplinary project team that works directly with our clients.

You will work hands-on with large and diverse datasets, transform raw data into clean, structured information, and contribute to the automation of our analytical workflows.

In close collaboration with internal analysts, engineers, and project managers, you will ensure that our healthcare data infrastructure remains reliable, scalable, and ready for future integration into the Statista Healthcare Data Platform.

Your work will directly support Statista’s mission to make healthcare quality measurable, comparable, and actionable - globally.

Responsibilities

  • Support in maintaining and further developing Statista’s ranking and rating databases, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and scalability

  • Collaborate on data pilots and benchmarking projects — from design and metric development to scoring and results analysis, interacting directly with our clients as part of an interdisciplinary Statista project team

  • Integrate, clean, and standardize external datasets from hospitals, ministries, and partners for unified use in Statista’s healthcare products

  • Develop and document data models and scoring frameworks in alignment with the Healthcare Analysis and IT teams

  • Support the development of Statista’s Unified Health Database and future Healthcare Data Platform

  • Perform internal analyses and reporting to improve data quality and performance metrics of existing healthcare products

  • Ensure data validation and reproducibility, including peer review and internal QA checks.

  • Actively contribute ideas for new data-driven healthcare products and improvement of existing workflows

  • Proven skills in Python and SQL, proven experience with data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar), including dashboard design and storytelling with data

  • Strong analytical mindset and ability to transform complex data into actionable insights

title: Content Marketer (f/m/x) - AI-First
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Doinstruct
description_html:
🌟 What we do & why we do it

Founded in 2021 in Osnabrück, Germany, doinstruct is on a mission to empower the backbone of our society - the frontline workforce - by making workplaces safer, more compliant, and more efficient. We don’t just improve training; we redefine how industries onboard and upskill their teams.

The problem? Outdated, inefficient training methods that fail to meet the needs of the deskless workforce - the 80% of global workers overlooked by traditional learning solutions. We saw the gap and built a seamless, mobile-first platform that makes onboarding, training, and compliance effortless, multilingual, and accessible - anytime, anywhere.

At doinstruct, we don’t accept the status quo. We innovate, we challenge, we build. Our vision is bold: Operational excellence for frontline teams starts here. We cut through the noise of clunky, ineffective training with an engaging, user-friendly experience available in 35+ languages - no downloads, no passwords - just instant access to the skills that drive industries forward.

🚀 Join us if you’re ready to build something extraordinary. We’re growing fast and looking for ambitious minds who thrive in a fast-paced, high-impact environment. If you’re passionate about solving big problems, shaping the future of workplace learning, and working alongside a driven team that moves fast and thinks big, doinstruct is where you belong.

___

The role

This is a hands-on role, requiring native-level German and working English proficiency.

doinstruct builds software that helps organizations train and enable their frontline teams, the people in factories, logistics, and service environments who are hardest to reach with conventional L&D. Our customers are manufacturers, industrial operators, and traditional enterprises.

As a key part of our marketing team, you’ll get to flex your strategic, research, and creative skills writing and creating content with two specific goals: Educate our audience (Thought leadership) and convert them (Acquisition). You own both end-to-end.

You will create high-value content in the form of blog articles, case studies, landing page copy, and white papers, collaborating closely with internal subject matter experts. For shoots and videos, you’ll use your storytelling superpowers to develop concepts and manage external production partners.

AI is an expected part of your workflow. You leverage the speed and efficiency technology affords with the taste only humans possess to create credible content worth reading.

If you have a journalistic curiosity, understand B2B audiences, and know how to build a content engine from the ground up - let’s talk!

🎯 What you'll own

  • Translate frontline realities, industry insights, trends, analysis, and product communication into content that resonates with buyers who don't live in generic SaaS marketing.

  • Plan and produce content across formats (website, blog, video, social) that performs in both traditional search and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, and adjust based on what you’ve measured.

  • Use AI tools as your default production layer: drafting, repurposing, ideation, research, so you can ship more, faster, without sacrificing quality.

  • Produce German-first content (that’s also translated in English), and work closely with the wider GTM team on broader copy requirements like campaigns and sales decks.

  • Brand tone of voice, ensuring consistency and differentiation

🙋 Who you are

  • You've produced content professionally and have a portfolio or examples.

  • You have a journalistic mindset - able to interview subject matter experts to extract insights, hooks, and stories.

  • You're fluent in German, comfortable writing and speaking it professionally. You’re also comfortable collaborating, presenting, and working at a professional proficiency in English.

  • You’ve already restructured how you work around AI - whether that's tracking AI visibility with something like Profound or Peec AI, producing multilingual content with tools like ElevenLabs or HeyGen, or researching with Perplexity instead of defaulting to Google. (If your content workflow looks basically the same as it did two years ago, this probably isn’t for you.)

  • Bonus, not a requirement: you've worked with or around frontline, industrial, or blue-collar audiences and understand operator priorities.

🤩 What's different here

You're not maintaining an existing content machine; you're bringing a new brand strategy to life; experimenting; and building a content function. That means real ambiguity, but also a chance to have outsized impact on a rapidly scaling business.

🚀 Why doinstruct

  • 400+ customers, Series A funded, below 2% churn. The product is a genuine must-have, which gives you real stories to tell.

  • We're moving AI-first as a company and will actively help you get deeper into AI tooling, because that's the direction we're going.

  • You're joining a GTM org that's still forming its shape, so what you build sticks.

📈 What success looks like

3 months You've got a content production rhythm running across formats, you understand our frontline buyer personas firsthand, and you’re identifying opportunities.

6 months Content you've produced is showing up in AI answer engines for queries that matter to us, and you can point to the pipeline it's driving. You’ve established strong partnerships with stakeholders both internally and externally.

12 months There's a repeatable content engine that treats AI answer engines as a first-class channel alongside traditional search. Content is having a measurable impact on revenue.

____

At doinstruct, you'll have the chance to use your skills and help shape our growing start-up. We value a friendly work environment, open communication, and support your personal and professional growth every step of the way.

Even if you don't tick all of the boxes, but you are motivated and want to work with us, you are very welcome to apply.

We embrace diversity and hire people based on their ability to perform a job. People of any race, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, political opinion, or marital status are welcome at doinstruct.
