salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Roadsurfer
description_html:
Warum roadsurfer?

  • TEAMSPIRIT & TEAMEVENTS: Freu dich auf eine kollegiale Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien, jede Menge Spaß und großartigem Teamspirit sowie regelmäßige Teamevents wie gemeinsame Sportsessions, Grillabende oder einfach nur ein Feierabenddrink an deiner Station.

  • AUSTAUSCHPROGRAMM: Tausche deinen Arbeitsplatz mit einem deiner europaweiten Kolleg:innen und arbeite bis zu vier Wochen im Jahr an den schönsten Orten Europas.

  • CAMPER BUDGET: Du bekommst eine jährliche Freimiete für unsere Camper, damit du den #happyroadsurfing Lifestyle selbst erleben kannst.

  • JOBRAD: Bleibe fit mit unserem Angebot eines Jobrads.

  • DISCOUNTS: Nutze unsere Corporate Benefits Plattform, die Travel Industry Card und Family & Friends Rabatte.

Deine Mission

Du willst Procurement nicht verwalten, sondern aufbauen - mit einem Team, klaren Prozessen und einem neuen ERP-System als Fundament? Als Teamlead Procurement übernimmst du den Lead unseres Einkaufsteams und gestaltest gleichzeitig die Einführung unseres neuen ERP-Systems (SAP) aktiv mit.

 

roadsurfer wächst schnell – über 10.000 Fahrzeuge, rund 100 Stationen in 15 Ländern. Ein Einkauf, der mit diesem Wachstum mithält, braucht saubere Prozesse, verlässliche Lieferantenbeziehungen und ein System, das alles trägt. Genau hier setzt du an: Du professionalisierst unseren Procurement-Bereich, baust eine interne Ersatzteil-Lieferkette an unsere Stationen auf und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Beschaffungsprozesse im neuen ERP von Anfang an richtig aufgesetzt sind

Die Rolle - deine Leidenschaft

  • Du führst, entwickelst und coachst das Procurement-Team und schaffst eine Struktur, in der eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten eine wichtige Rolle spielt.

  • Du bist Hauptansprechpartner aus dem Einkauf im laufenden SAP-Einführungsprojekt – von der Aufnahme der Anforderungen über das Prozessdesign (Purchase-to-Pay) bis zu Tests, Datenmigration und Go-live.

  • Du optimierst die interne Supply Chain für Ersatzteile an unseren Stationen auf – von Sortiment und Lieferanten über Lagerhaltung, Mindestbestände und Distributionslogik bis zur Versorgung der Maintenance & Repair-Teams vor Ort.

  • Du definierst und standardisierst Beschaffungsprozesse, Richtlinien und Freigabe-Workflows und überführst sie in das neue System.

  • Du verantwortest die Auswahl, Bewertung und Weiterentwicklung von Lieferanten sowie das Vertrags- und Konditionenmanagement.

  • Du führst Verhandlungen bei strategisch wichtigen Warengruppen und realisierst messbare Einsparungen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Finance, Fleet, Operations, Legal und IT zusammen und vertrittst die Einkaufsperspektive in cross-funktionalen Projekten.

  • Du treibst den Einsatz von KI und Automatisierung im Einkauf voran (z. B. n8n-Workflows, KI-gestützte Auswertungen), um Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten und das Team von Routinearbeit zu entlasten.

  • Du baust Procurement-KPIs auf und steuerst den Einkauf datenbasiert (z. B. Einsparungen, Lieferzuverlässigkeit und Prozessdurchlaufzeiten).

Was du brauchst, um mit uns auf einer Welle zu surfen

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im strategischen oder operativen Einkauf, davon nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Führung eines Teams.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit SAP (z. B. MM / Ariba) ODER nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Einführung eines ERP-Systems – idealerweise beides.

  • Tiefes Verständnis von End-to-End-Beschaffungsprozessen (Purchase-to-Pay) und der Fähigkeit, sie zu standardisieren und zu digitalisieren.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder Betrieb einer Supply Chain bzw. Ersatzteil-/Materialversorgung (Sortiment, Lagerhaltung, Bestandssteuerung, Distribution) ist ein klares Plus.

title: Senior Go Backend Developer (Dashboard Analytics) (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at adjoe
description_html:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Transforming 50M+ daily events into real-time actionable dashboard insights

The Dashboards team is responsible for the systems and interfaces that define our partners' daily operations. We build the campaign management APIs, analytics engines, and high-throughput tools that allow advertisers and publishers to configure, monitor, and optimize their activity on our platform.

This is not about simple CRUD interfaces, it is about building high-performance data surfaces that drive massive business decisions. Using Go, Kafka, and Druid, we process and render real-time analytics across 50+ million daily events, ensuring accuracy and complex campaign performance reporting at scale. On the frontend, we tackle genuine engineering constraints: utilizing TypeScript and React, we have moved beyond standard library limitations to build highly optimized graph-rendering with Recharts capable of visualizing datasets that would overload conventional solutions.

 

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • Go is your primary language at scale. You have 5+ years in software development with 3+ years building production Go services. You've worked on high-traffic systems handling 100M+ requests per day, and you know how to profile and optimize Go applications — not just identify that something is slow, but fix it.

  • Distributed systems are your default. You design and operate microservice architectures using event buses like Kafka and SQS/SNS for reliable asynchronous communication. At adjoe, you'll be collecting and aggregating billions of daily API events into Kafka and Kinesis streams, queryable from the data lake in seconds.

  • Data performance matters to you. You work with columnar databases like Druid and relational databases like MySQL, optimizing queries to deliver few-millisecond response times. You understand the difference between how data should be stored and how it should be queried at scale.

  • Partner-facing data ownership. You'll support partners by providing raw or aggregated data through well-documented open APIs, backed by TypeScript React dashboards on the frontend. You believe in data transparency and build APIs that reflect that.

  • Infrastructure fluency is a plus. Experience with Terraform, Docker, or serverless infrastructure helps when owning services end-to-end in a Kubernetes-based environment. Columnar database experience is a strong plus

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

title: Senior Go Backend Developer (Supply Integrations Team) (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at adjoe
description_html:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

 

Processing 2+ million daily interactions between adjoe's reward engine and its global publisher network

The Supply Integrations team builds and operates the services that ensure every user reward is calculated, verified, and delivered, whether that means firing a cryptographically signed HTTP callback in milliseconds or transferring loyalty points through a partner's OAuth-secured payment API. Every callback that lands on time is a reward delivered, a publisher retained, and revenue protected.

The team's production surface spans a set of services connecting adjoe to a global publisher network. S2S Payout Callbacks deliver real-time reward notifications with 40+ configurable parameters, secured by per-publisher cryptographic signatures. The Payout Adapter integrates directly with enterprise partner payment systems, handling OAuth2 flows, mTLS, HMAC signatures, and retry logic to guarantee delivery. Our External Statistics API aggregates data from Druid, Athena, and DynamoDB into self-serve publisher dashboards and daily reports. All of this is backed by Go microservices communicating over Kafka and SQS, with state managed in DynamoDB and MySQL, processing over 2 million interactions every day without missing a beat.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For

  • Production Golang Systems Expertise: You bring 5+ years of backend development experience, including at least 3 years writing Go in production distributed environments. You will build and maintain our +99% Go microservice architecture—interfacing with our TypeScript/React frontend—to reliably handle 2+ million daily publisher interactions and scale beyond hundreds of millions of monthly active users.

  • High-Throughput Event Streaming: You have hands-on experience designing asynchronous microservice communication using event buses like Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Kinesis. You will build pipelines to collect billions of daily API events and aggregate them into our data lake for sub-second querying.

  • High-Scale Data & API Optimization: You understand database internals and low-level web standards (HTTP protocol, Encoding, Regular Expressions). You will optimize queries across hundreds of terabytes of data across DynamoDB, MySQL, Druid, and Athena to reduce API response times and expose transparent, well-documented open APIs to enterprise partners.

  • Data Science & Algorithmic Integration: You quickly grasp complex technical topics and applied mathematics. You will partner directly with our Data Science team to translate and integrate machine learning algorithms into adjoe’s core application, optimizing real-time ad targeting.

  • Collaborative Technical Communication: You communicate fluently and precisely in spoken and written English. You will actively participate in peer code reviews and technical knowledge sharing across an international backend engineering team.

  • Plus: Infrastructure & Cloud Tooling: Hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code), Docker containerization, or serverless infrastructure.

With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Identifying fraudulent patterns across 400 Million Daily Events

More than 440 million ad events flow through our systems daily, and the Advertising Analytics team is responsible for understanding, improving, and safeguarding that ad delivery system.

With over 2,000 games from top studios around the world, Anti-Fraud Data Analysts dig into the behavioural and technical data points. They investigate, analyse, and experiment with fraud prevention algorithms across complex, asynchronous ad delivery systems, using Python and Airflow to build the analytical infrastructure that makes that possible. The team owns the analytical layer behind fraud detection: tracking suspicious behavior, monitoring traffic quality, and alerting on anomalies, translating investigative findings into clear data-driven decisions that protect advertisers, safeguard revenue, and enable trusted business scale-up.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • The go-to anti-fraud person for business stakeholders. You'll own the first line of technical knowledge for our Anti-Fraud unit, working directly with business stakeholders. You translate complex data findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Analytically sharp, technically grounded. You have 2+ years in a Data, AdOps, or BizOps role and work fluently in SQL — CTEs, joins, aggregations. At adjoe, you'll be diagnosing and investigating issues across systems that process 440 million ad events daily.

  • You thrive in analysing complex, asynchronous systems. Ad delivery at adjoe spans complex pipelines across 2,000+ advertiser games. Use your analytical skills to diagnose, resolve, or prioritize technical and data-related anti-fraud issues.

  • Builds for scale, not just for now. You think beyond one-off analysis, contributing to reporting, monitoring, and alerting systems that serve global operations. Experience with Airflow, dbt, or API integrations is a plus.

  • Familiar with BI tooling. You've worked with tools like Tableau, Power BI, QuickSight, or similar.

  • Plus: background in Anti-Fraud or anomaly detection.

  • Plus: background in AdTech or mobile app analytics.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

title: Enterprise Account Executive (Germany)

description_html:
Who We Are

Having surpassed $300M ARR and continuing to grow, Optro helps enterprises transform risk into opportunity through its AI-powered GRC Intelligence Platform. More than 50% of the Fortune 500, including 7 of the Fortune 10, leverage our award-winning technology to move their businesses forward with greater clarity and agility. And our customers love us: Optro is top-rated on G2.com and Gartner Peer Insights.

At Optro, we inspire each other to innovate and are proud of what we are producing. We spend each day thinking of new ways to help our customers and contribute to the greater good of our company and our surrounding communities. We are all about assisting each other and breaking through barriers to create the most loved audit, risk, ESG, and InfoSec platform by our customers. This is how we have become one of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America for the seventh year in a row, as ranked by Deloitte!

Why This Role is Exciting

At Optro, we empower businesses with award-winning technology that transforms risk into strategic advantage. As we continue our expansion in the DACH region, we are looking for an experienced Enterprise Account Executive to drive meaningful business outcomes with our innovative solutions.

If you are a relationship-driven sales professional with a consultative mindset and a passion for delivering value to enterprise customers, this is your opportunity to shape the future of risk and compliance in one of Europe’s most advanced economies.


**Ideal location for this role would be Munich, Germany (Remote), with possibility of hybrid options in the future

Opportunities in This Role

  • Work alongside a mission-driven team that values integrity, excellence, and shared success.

  • Thrive in a collaborative culture that celebrates high performance and continuous improvement.

  • Enjoy flexibility with remote-based working.

  • Be part of a high-growth company recognized as a Great Place to Work, where your impact is visible and rewarded.

  • Access competitive compensation, professional development, and career advancement opportunities

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts—including both publicly listed and privately held companies—across the DACH region.

  • Drive new logo acquisition and existing customer expansion, contributing directly to our growth in a key European market.

  • Operate from your home office in Germany, with travel to clients as needed or our London based AuditBoard office.

  • Report directly to the Director, Sales and work cross-functionally with regional and global teams.

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with C-level stakeholders by understanding their challenges and mapping them to AuditBoard’s platform capabilities.

  • Collaborate across Pre-Sales, Business Value Consulting, and Marketing, leveraging tools, partners, and events to drive pipeline and deal progression.

  • Partner with the strategic alliances to deliver integrated, customer-centric outcomes.

Attributes for a Successful Candidate 

  • 5–7 years of experience in enterprise technology sales, ideally in SaaS or GRC software solutions.

  • Proven success in complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing high-value deals.

  • Demonstrated experience in value-based selling and establishing long-term client partnerships.

  • Native-level German fluency and excellent English communication skills (both verbal and written).

  • A collaborative mindset and experience working cross-functionally with global teams

  • Comfortable leveraging structured sales frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Challenger Sale).

  • A learning-oriented mindset and a desire to grow within a fast-paced, international environment.

  • Familiarity with German regulatory environments and enterprise procurement expectations.

Perks (Germany)

  • Launch a career at one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in North America and EMEA!

  • Monthly work from home allowance

  • Competitive compensation & bonus program

  • Company paid pension contribution

  • Annual Leave: 30 days

  • Employee resource groups

  • Opportunities for team and company-wide get-togethers!

*perks may vary based on eligibility/location

Our Company Values

  • Customer obsession: It starts and ends here. Consistently ask yourself how what you’re doing creates value for our customers. It’s a mindset.

  • Gritty resilience: Make it happen. Find a way. Move fast, stay positive, and do what it takes.

  • Drive innovation: Create the future. Continuously improve what exists and invent what’s next.

  • Win, together: One team. No silos, no egos. Drive to be the best and support each other’s success.

  • Growth mindset: 10x, not 10%. Think in orders of magnitude, not increments. Seek feedback, learn, and improve.


Please note that background checks are required. Qualified Applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for Employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. This role may have access to highly sensitive data, including employee data, customer data, company financials, and proprietary product information.

We love building strong partnerships, but please note that Optro cannot accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Any submissions without a signed agreement in place will not create a fee obligation.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Incidents
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Mapbox
description_html:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

We build the mission-critical engine that powers real-time navigation for Mapbox's largest global customers. We process petabytes of geospatial data through a sophisticated blend of high-scale backend services, data pipelines, and AI Agentic workflows to detect, validate, and deliver live road updates - from traffic jams to road closures. The intelligent AI agents we build enhance our core algorithms, ensuring Mapbox maps are as dynamic as the roads themselves and that millions of drivers reach their destinations in the most optimal way possible.

Engineers on this team develop and deliver of every stage of the incident lifecycle:

  1. Intelligent Ingestion and Detection: Build automated AI agents to gather data and discover closures using proprietary Mapbox signals.

  2. Validation and Conflation: Leverage algorithms to invalidate stale data and merge duplicate reports into a single, high-fidelity source of truth.

  3. Strategic Delivery: Design the systems that expose this data across the entire Mapbox ecosystem.

  4. AI Collaboration: Partner with the MapGPT team to evolve our Feedback Agent, allowing us to refine the map using real-time customer insights.

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

What You'll Do

As a Software Development Engineer II (Senior) on the Incidents team, you can expect to:

  • Collaborate with your team to identify and scope out well-defined tasks.

  • Execute on the scope and be accountable for delivering on time with quality.

  • Design systems and make decisions that will keep pace with the rapid growth of Mapbox’s customer base.

  • Promote a culture of operational excellence by meticulously testing and monitoring our systems and code, writing documentation, and being on-call to support the health of our services.

  • Reduce technical debt, share your knowledge, and invest in your teammates’ health and happiness, while optimizing application performance and accelerating feature velocity.

  • Uphold a culture of collaboration, transparency, creativity, inclusion, and data-driven decisions.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 5+ years of full-time backend focused development

  • 3+ years of working with distributed systems. Preferably with AWS based tools or Azure/GCP alternatives

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams of 5+ people

  • 3+ years of product focused development

Employment Type: Full-time

Location/Hybrid Policy: Fully remote

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

Our annual compensation for this role ranges from $92,000 - $133,000 (salaries are in EUR). Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role).

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application.

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Kubernetes

description_html:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

We’re seeking a talented engineer to develop and maintain Kubernetes Operators for our Camunda 8 SaaS offering. You’ll play a vital role in ensuring the reliability of our cloud platform, managing numerous customer clusters and tackling complex challenges related to Kubernetes, infrastructure automation, and multi-cloud deployments across GCP and AWS. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on our software and processes.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Design, develop, and maintain Kubernetes Operators to manage the Camunda SaaS offering. Your work will directly contribute to helping Camunda deliver a robust platform with world-class reliability used by customers globally across all industries.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, field) to define, ship, and iterate on features. You will work with high calibre teams on projects that will extend Camunda’s SaaS across clouds, enable multi-region deployments, and deliver world-class security features used by some of the largest enterprises world-wide.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve existing codebase(s) for security, stability, and reliability. You will be part of a team that cares deeply about quality and reliability and make contributions that extend our reliability objectives.

  • Be an advocate for new ideas and help build a team environment that values both creativity and practicality. Your work will have impact across Camunda’s engineering organization, directly influencing outcomes, and enable a world-class SaaS experience

  • Participate in an on-call rotation and 3rd level escalation support to ensure the system is meeting its objectives.

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

  •  Experience using Go or another relevant language for cloud native software development.

  • Practical experience with at least one major Cloud Service Provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and a deep understanding of its core concepts.

  • Willingness to work collaboratively within a team, share knowledge, and contribute to a positive engineering culture.

  • Own your systems end-to-end – You'll adopt a "you build it, you run it" mentality, which means participating in on-call rotations and being the go-to person when things need quick fixes. You'll create runbooks and automation that turn complex problems into manageable processes.

  • Ship features and improvements with product teams – Work cross-functionally with product engineering, product management, and support to define and deliver features that move the needle. Bring your expertise to the table early and often.

  • Push automation to the next level – Identify repetitive work and automate it away. Share what you learn with your teammates so everyone gets better at their craft. We measure progress by the quality of our systems, not hours worked.

  • Be the expert others learn from – Help less experienced engineers tackle complex infrastructure challenges. Break down technical problems into clear steps and support others in growing their skills. 

What You Bring:

Must Haves:

  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes – You've built, deployed, and maintained Kubernetes clusters in production environments. You understand how to manage workloads, networking, and storage at scale.

  • Demonstrated experience in monitoring and observability – You've worked with tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms to instrument systems and alert on what matters.

  • Strong 3rd-level support and incident response skills – You've responded to production incidents, diagnosed complex issues, and communicated clearly with stakeholders under pressure. You understand root cause analysis and how to prevent issues from happening again.

  • A passion for automation and raising the quality bar – You see manual work as a problem to be solved. You care deeply about building systems that are reliable, maintainable, and easy to understand.

  • Responsible use of AI tools – You leverage AI for research, code review, documentation, test generation, and automation to improve your effectiveness. You know how to validate AI outputs against requirements, never share confidential or personal data with AI systems without authorization, and always retain human accountability for decisions and deliverables.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with major cloud providers – You've worked with AWS (EKS), Google Cloud Platform (GKE), or similar managed Kubernetes services.

  • ArgoCD or GitOps workflows – You've used declarative, Git-driven infrastructure management to keep systems in sync.

  • Proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages – You write scripts and automation tools that solve real problems.

  • Experience with SLOs and alerting frameworks – You've helped teams define meaningful service level objectives and set up alerts that don't cry wolf.

Beyond content, you'll help maintain and configure the infrastructure that keeps our documentation running smoothly. We're looking for someone who can unblock themselves and the team when something breaks. Day to day, this can mean:

  • Troubleshooting and fixing failing GitHub Actions workflows, including reading CI logs, isolating the breaking change, and getting the build green again.

  • Reviewing and merging contributions from engineers and the wider community, and keeping branches and versioned docs releases in good shape.

  • Diagnosing broken links, redirects, MDX and rendering errors, and search indexing issues across current and versioned content.

  • Handling Docusaurus, Node, and dependency upgrades, and resolving the breakages that come with them.

  • Improving the tooling, automation, and linting that writers and contributors rely on, so our publishing process stays fast and predictable

You don't need to be a full-time developer, but you should be confident with Git and GitHub workflows, the command line, YAML and JavaScript-based config, Markdown/MDX, and reading an error trace far enough to know whether you can fix it or need to pull in an engineer.

You'll join a collaborative, mission-driven team focused on helping developers become productive with Camunda technologies quickly and joyfully. Developers with technical writing experience are encouraged to apply.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  1. Own and drive the documentation for one or more product areas, acting as the embedded technical writer within the corresponding product teams.

  2. Maintain and improve our documentation site's technical infrastructure, including build tooling, deployment pipelines, and Docusaurus platform configuration, to keep publishing fast, reliable, and scalable.

  3. Work closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to stay deeply informed about the product roadmap and ensure documentation is accurate, timely, and aligned with feature development.

  4. Become a subject matter expert in your assigned product areas, developing hands-on experience with Camunda products to create documentation that reflects real-world usage and developer needs.

  5. Lead documentation efforts from concept through to release, including planning, writing, reviewing, and maintaining content that empowers developers to succeed with Camunda technologies.

  6. Advocate for documentation as a critical part of the user experience, bringing the user’s perspective into product discussions and influencing design and implementation where appropriate.

  7. Continuously improve the structure, clarity, and completeness of the documentation based on analytics, user feedback, and your own insights.

  8. Collaborate with other writers and the broader Documentation team to share best practices, contribute to team goals, and evolve our documentation tooling and standards.

What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of technical writing experience and a strong portfolio of developer-focused content such as user guides, installation guides, API references, tutorials, and technical blog posts.

  • Proven experience of maintaining, troubleshooting, configuring, and extending documentation site infrastructure and deployment pipelines, preferably using Docusaurus.

  • Hands-on experience with Java, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, and related technologies, and a proven ability to deeply understand, use, and test complex technical products (ideally with Camunda 8 or similar products).

  • Proven ability to tailor content for diverse audiences and technical backgrounds, including software engineers, application developers, business analysts, and process owners.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Software engineering experience, or proficiency with one or more programming languages.

  • Comfortable iterating on an existing technical writing style guide and advocating for its cross-functional use.

title: Principal Mechanical Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at The Exploration Company
description_html:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.


We are looking for a Principal Mechanical Engineer, to lead the Mechanical Engineering discipline for Nyx Earth, ensuring that mechanical systems are robust, justified, verified, and ready for flight.

As a Principal you will manage a team of Mechanical Engineers, drive structural design and verification activities, and ensure technical excellence across structural analysis, testing, qualification, and verification. You will coordinate your work with the Principal CAD Engineer and with the Vehicle Mechanical Architect, under the guidance of the Mechanical Design Lead. You will play a key role in enabling the successful development of one of Europe's most ambitious space vehicles.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the Mechanical Engineering team, defining priorities, supporting growth, and ensuring engineering excellence and delivery.

  • Support and collaborate to the mechanical design of the spacecraft and its major assemblies, ensuring structurally efficient, robust, manufacturable, and verifiable design solutions throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Provide technical leadership on the design of primary and secondary structures, large assemblies, equipment supports, and critical mechanical interfaces, ensuring consistency between design intent, structural justification, and verification strategy.

  • Own structural justification activities across the spacecraft, ensuring consistency of assumptions, margins, analyses, and engineering evidence.

  • Coordinate structural analyses and mechanical verification activities, with focus on test strategy and execution, from test definition and prediction to result interpretation and model correlation, ensuring results are coherent, traceable, and aligned with programme objectives.

  • Ensure verification evidence generated through testing and analysis is robust, review-ready, and suitable for qualification and certification activities towards space agencies.

  • Drive technical reviews, risk identification, and engineering maturity assessments to ensure readiness for major programme milestones.

  • Act as a hands-on technical leader, actively contributing to engineering decisions, test campaigns, anomaly investigations, and troubleshooting efforts.

What We Would Love to See from You

Qualifications:

  • Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

  • More than 10 years experience in spacecraft, launch vehicle, aerospace, defence, or other high-performance engineering environments.

  • Strong background in structure design, structural analysis, justification, qualification, and verification.

  • Proven experience leading engineering teams and developing technical talent.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex structural test campaigns, from preparation and prediction through execution and data interpretation.

title: Brand & Product Marketing
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Atira
description_html:
About Atira

Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.

We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!

Why this role is a blank canvas

Brand is the one asset that compounds while everything else at a startup resets. Every deck, every customer story, every post builds on the last one, and the person who builds that foundation owns something no later hire can claim.

You will be one of the first people on our GTM team and the first owner of how Atira looks, sounds, and gets found: our positioning, our visual identity, our customer stories, and our presence in a market where no one has built a great brand yet. You work directly with the founders, who stay hands-on with positioning while you turn it into something the whole company builds on. And you won't start from zero: you'll build on our recently completed rebranding with a top-tier design agency and turn the new identity into everything Atira ships.

You won't be someone who "supports marketing" at Atira. You'll build a company's brand from scratch in one of the hardest, most valuable B2B markets there is.

How the role sits in the team

You are the first person at Atira whose full-time job is brand and marketing. You will define how Atira presents itself to the public, both from a strategic and operational perspective. The role sits at the heart of our GTM team with our BDR, AE, and GTM Engineer, and you work across every department: sales needs decks and stories, engineering needs a tech blog, product needs launches told in buyer language, recruiting needs an employer brand. You are the connective tissue that makes all of it look and sound like one company.

What you will do

You will shape how Atira presents itself to the public, across every medium: text, visuals, web, fairs, and events. Concretely:

  • Build the messaging foundation. Together with the founders, constantly refine who Atira is for, what we claim, and why we win

  • Own the visual identity. Consistent design across website, decks, product touchpoints, and events. You own the design system and the rules it is built upon

  • Make Atira visible. LinkedIn presence, customer stories, industry fairs and events. The goal is measurable: inbound interest and recognition among our target buyers and recruiting prospects

  • Grow into product marketing. Once the foundation stands, translate product capability into buyer language: launch narratives, one-pagers, demo storylines, side by side with our engineers and FDEs

What we are looking for

Creativity, hunger, structure, and the kind of taste that makes Atira iconic. We care more about who you are than about your CV. We have hired strong people from non-traditional backgrounds before and will confidently do it again.

That said, here is what we typically see in strong candidates:

  • Trained in a high-performing environment. 2+ years as part of a larger marketing or brand team, or under a strong marketing lead, at a startup, scaleup, or agency. You learned the craft from experienced people before owning it alone

  • Ownership evidence. You have owned a brand-shaped project end to end: rebuilt a startup's messaging and deck, ran a rebrand or website relaunch, or built a founder's LinkedIn presence to real reach

  • Craft. Your portfolio shows crisp writing and strong visual judgment. At Atira we highly value people who have clear opinions and are not afraid to share them!

  • Complex B2B exposure. Experience with, or demonstrated affinity for, technical or industrial B2B. You can talk to engineers and buyers without losing them

  • Self-directed. Comfortable owning the function alone, setting your own priorities, and shipping without a team

  • German + English. Fluent German for DACH industrial buyers and events, excellent English for global content

What you'll get

  • Real ownership. You are the first brand hire and build the function from zero. The brand Atira carries into the next hundred hires is the one you built

  • Direct line to the founders. You work hands-on with them on positioning and turn founder knowledge into public presence

  • Validated traction to work with. Leading industrial customers, several with revenues above €1B, and real stories waiting to be told

  • A rebrand to build on. Fully redesigned branding guidelines from our recently completed rebranding exercise with a top-tier brand agency, ready for you to roll out and evolve

  • Competitive salary & equity package and additional benefits including Wellpass, JobRad and company dinners.

  • Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity.

What success looks like after a few months

  • Atira has a positioning and messaging foundation adopted company-wide, a deck and template system every team actually uses, and a refreshed look that reflects it

  • Target buyers recognize us: growing LinkedIn engagement from ICP accounts, 2-3 published customer stories, presence at a key industry event, and the first inbound leads traceable to your work

  • The content engine runs without founder prompting, and brand requests from sales and recruiting get handled with fast turnaround

DAS IST DER JOB


Als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Customer Support & Social Media Community Management (m/w/d) werden deine Hauptaufgaben sein:

  • Du bearbeitest schriftliche Kundenanfragen und löst nicht nur Probleme, sondern begeisterst mit schnellen, klaren und sympathischen Antworten. Gemeinsam mit unserem starken Team entwickelst du unsere Kundenzufriedenheit auf neue Höhen und gibst unseren Nutzer:innen das Gefühl, gehört zu werden.

  • Du moderierst und belebst unsere Community auf Social Media (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook). Kommentare, Fragen, Diskussionen – du bist mittendrin, sorgst für eine positive Atmosphäre und baust eine starke Beziehung zu unserer Community auf.

  • Durch den engen Austausch mit dem Social Media Content & Influencer Marketing Team, stellst du sicher, dass Fragen beantwortet und unsere Mission erlebbar kommuniziert wird.

  • Als fester Bestandteil unseres Customer Support Team fungierst du an der Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden, unserem Marketing, dem Produktmanagement, sowie unserer Logistik.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Pflege unserer internen Wissensdatenbank und des Help Centers auf unserer Website.


DAS BIST DU


Wenn du dich leidenschaftlich für Nachhaltigkeit engagieren möchtest und hochmotiviert bist, mit uns die Welt ein bisschen sauberer zu machen, dann finden wir dich richtig gut!
Wenn du außerdem gerne proaktiv und im Team arbeitest, und du jede kleine und große Herausforderung als eine Chance ansiehst, noch besser zu werden – dann sind wir schon ein ganz kleines bisschen verknallt.
Wenn du schließlich auch noch über die folgenden Skills und Erfahrungen verfügst, dann sind wir uns fast sicher: Das könnte der Beginn einer ganz großen Love Story sein!

  • Du suchst eine Werkstudierendentätigkeit mit 20 Wochenstunden, bei der du gleichermaßen anpackst und lernst (für mindestens 12 Monate).

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C2) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B2/C1). Du verfügst über (sehr) gute Französisch und/oder Italienisch und/ oder Polnisch Kenntnisse (C1), vor allem schriftlich.

  • Du studierst aktuell im Bachelor- oder Masterstudium Kommunikations-/Medienwissenschaften, Marketing (BWL mit Schwerpunkt Marketing), Online-Marketing / Digital Marketing, Sprachwissenschaften (Germanistik, Anglistik) oder eine vergleichbare Fachrichtung.

  • Du bist ein echtes Kommunikationstalent - du findest immer den richtigen Ton, bist präzise und kannst auch komplexe Dinge einfach erklären. Auch in stressigen Phasen.

  • Du arbeitest gewissenhaft und schnell.

  • Erste Erfahrungen im Customer Support sind ein Plus, aber deine Begeisterung und Antrieb dazu zu lernen sind uns noch wichtiger.


DAS IST EVERDROP


Unsere Mission 💚🌱🌎


Wir wollen die Welt verändern – gemeinsam mit dir! Die Alltagsprodukte von everdrop helfen den Menschen, ganz einfach ihren ökologischen Fußabdruck im Haushalt zu reduzieren. Im Jahr 2020 sind wir mit unseren Reiniger-Tabs gestartet. Seitdem haben unsere Haushalts- und Pflegeprodukte bereits mehr als 20 Millionen Einweg-Plastikflaschen und Tausende Tonnen unnötige CO2-Emissionen und chemische Rohstoffe eingespart. Seit 2023 sind wir übrigens eine zertifizierte B Corp. Und mit deiner Hilfe wollen wir everdrop aufs nächste Level bringen. Schließ dich unserer Mission an – und hilf uns, einen nachhaltigen Lifestyle so einfach zu machen, dass er zum neuen Standard in unserer Gesellschaft wird.


Unsere Benefits 🍲💪🏡

  • abwechslungsreiche, sinnstiftende und Purpose-getriebene Arbeit

  • großartiger Teamgeist und regelmäßige Team-Events

  • ein wunderschönes, helles, geräumiges Büro in der Nähe der Isar

  • eine Outdoor-Fitnessanlage neben dem Büro (jederzeit nutzbar)

  • ein monatlicher Gutschein über 30€ für everdrop Produkte

  • Familien- und Freunde-Rabattcodes für everdrop und andere Startups for Tomorrow-Unternehmen

  • Mitgliedschaft bei FutureBens & Corporate Benefits

  • flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Flexibilität: Wir freuen uns dich in unserem schönen Office in München zu sehen. Bei Bedarf kannst Du mind. einmal pro Woche remote arbeiten

  • zusätzlich 2 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr für eigene umwelt- oder gemeinnützige Projekte ("Green & Social Impact Days”)dein eigenes MacBook, solange du bei everdrop arbeitest


Unsere Werte 💛🏳️‍🌈🤝‍

Ein Beispiel dafür, wie wir am Arbeitsplatz Awareness schaffen möchten: Menstruierende Kolleg*innen, die unter Schmerzen leiden, können ganz einfach einen oder mehrere "Power Days" nehmen, zusätzliche bezahlte freie Tage. Und das ohne Fragen, ohne Rechtfertigungen. title: Werkstudent:in Business Security Consultancy
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Northwave Cyber Security
description_html:
Über Northwave

Unternehmen zu schützen, ist unsere Mission.

Bei Northwave verändern 275+ Cyber Security-Spezialist:innen die Art und Weise, wie Unternehmen und Organisationen digitale Sicherheit denken und umsetzen. Mit unserem Hauptsitz in Utrecht, unserem DACH-Headquarter in Leipzig sowie Standorten in Österreich, Schweden und Belgien sind wir europaweit vertreten.

Northwave verbindet Expertise im Ethical Hacking mit Erkenntnissen aus der Verhaltenspsychologie und modernstem Security Management auf höchstem Niveau. Wir reagieren nicht nur auf Bedrohungen, sondern erkennen sie frühzeitig. Mit unseren 24/7 Managed Security Services und maßgeschneiderten Lösungen begleiten wir unsere Kund:innen auf ihrem individuellen Weg zu mehr Sicherheit.

Wenn Du Teil von Northwave wirst, arbeitest Du in einem Umfeld, in dem Innovation zu echten Ergebnissen führt. Bei uns entwickelst Du Deine Expertise weiter und trägst aktiv dazu bei, die Zukunft der digitalen Sicherheit in unterschiedlichsten Branchen mitzugestalten.

Deine Mission

Du willst nicht einfach nur Akten wälzen, sondern die echte Welt der strategischen Management- und IT-Beratung hautnah kennenlernen? Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) in unserem Business Security Consulting Team arbeitest du direkt mit unserem Head of Consultancy DACH zusammen. 

Deine Mission ist es, die Brücke zwischen strategischen Geschäftszielen und den Herausforderungen der Cybersecurity zu schlagen. Du musst an Tag 1 kein technischer Deep-Dive-Experte sein – was für uns zählt, ist dein Drive, dein analytischer Verstand und dein Verständnis für Geschäftsmodelle. 

Deine Aufgaben: 

  • Sparringspartner in Training: Du unterstützt den Head of Consultancy direkt im strategischen Tagesgeschäft und bei der Steuerung des DACH-Beratungsgeschäfts. 

  • Consulting hautnah: Du begleitest Kundenprojekte in den Bereichen Cybersecurity-Strategie, Risikomanagement und Compliance (z.B. NIS2, CRA, ISO 27001) und lernst das Handwerkszeug der Top-Beratung von der Pike auf. 

  • Business & Cyber: Du analysierst Geschäftsmodelle, bereitest Marktrecherchen auf und hilfst dabei, abstrakte Bedrohungen in pragmatische, wertschöpfende Strategien für das C-Level zu übersetzen. 

  • Content Creation: Du erstellst Management-Präsentationen, Reports und Workshop-Materialien, die komplexe Sachverhalte auf den Punkt bringen. 

Das erwartet Dich bei uns

  • Das Wichtigste zuerst: Dein Studium steht an erster Stelle. Daher findet die Abstimmung deiner Arbeitszeiten immer im Austausch mit dir und unter Berücksichtigung deines Semesterplans statt. Zudem bieten wir dir einen attraktiven Stundenlohn (über Mindestlohn) und sechs Wochen Urlaub im Jahr.

  • Unser Büro ist mit Apple Geräten, höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen und einem stets mit kühlen Getränkengefüllten Kühlschrank ausgestattet.  Ach ja, und es gibt regelmäßig Merch im Northwave Design, sowie Kuchenund niederländische Karamellwaffeln.

  • Bei Northwave bist du Teil eines internationalen Teams aus Security-Enthusiat:innen, die gerne ihr Wissen teilen und sich über Unterstützung z.B. beim Firmenlauf oder dem Pub Quiz freuen. In Deutschland befinden wir uns noch im Aufbau - deine Chance also, mitzugestalten.


  • Lust auf Beratung: Du hast den absoluten Willen, die Consulting-Welt zu erobern und bist bereit, dich mit Hands-on-Mentalität in neue, komplexe Themenstellungen einzuarbeiten. 

  • Mindset & Drive: Begeisterungsfähigkeit, grenzenlose Neugier und ein extrem hoher Lernwille sind für dich selbstverständlich. 

  • Business First: Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes betriebswirtschaftliches Denken. Ein echtes Interesse für Cybersecurity ist Pflicht – genauso wichtig ist aber das Verständnis dafür, dass IT-Sicherheit immer auch einen "Business Value" liefern muss. 

  • Background: Eingeschrieben an einer Hochschule? Check. Was genau du studierst (von Kunstgeschichte bis Informatik), ist uns dabei völlig egal. Wir suchen keine reinen Theorie-Experten, sondern Macher mit Hands-on-Mentalität und einem messerscharfen Verstand. 

  • Skills: Du bringst eine strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit. 

  • Perspektive: Du wirst Teil eines internationalen Teams von Cybersecurity-Enthusiasten. Da unsere deutsche Organisation kontinuierlich wächst, hast du die einmalige Chance, unsere Zukunft mitzugestalten und dich langfristig bei uns weiterzuentwickeln. 

     

Interessiert?

Du bist Dir noch nicht ganz sicher? Dann schau Dir an, wie das Arbeiten bei Northwave aussieht: Karriere bei Northwave.

Wenn Du bereit bist, mit uns die digitale Zukunft sicherer zu machen, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

title: Working Student Ground Robotics (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Quantum-Systems GmbH
description_html:
As a Working Student Ground Robotics, you will support our predevelopment team in turning early-stage ideas into safe and measurable prototypes. You will work on tracked demonstrators and innovative exploration projects.

Together with engineers from Systems Engineering, Mechatronics, Embedded Development, and Verification, you will support the preparation of prototypes, tests, and technical demonstrations.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Take ownership of a clearly scoped module or work package within Ground Robotics projects, supported by an experienced engineer

  • Clarify requirements and interfaces, develop a concept and compare practical solution options.

  • Design a mechanical assembly, an electrical unit or a software module, depending on your interests and strengths.

  • Create the required CAD, drawings, wiring documentation, code, configuration or parts list.

  • Build and integrate your solution into the prototype together with the project team.

  • Plan and perform suitable bench or vehicle tests, evaluate results and improve the design where needed.

  • Document your work and present progress and results in technical reviews.


What you bring to the team:

  • You are studying mechanical engineering, mechatronics, electrical engineering, robotics, computer science or a comparable subject.

  • You enjoy hands-on technical work and are curious about mobile robots and prototypes.

  • You have some practical experience from a university project, student team, internship, hobby project or workshop work.

  • You bring basic knowledge in at least one area: CAD and mechanics, electronics and wiring, Python/Linux, embedded systems, testing or data

    evaluation.

  • You work carefully, reliably and document what you have done.

  • You ask questions when something is unclear and enjoy learning from others.

  • You can communicate in English; German is helpful.

Why Quantum-Systems:

We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working.

Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.

About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.

Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

title: Tech Lead (Agent Frontend) (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Recare Deutschland GmbH
description_html:
About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

What to expect as our Tech Lead (Agent Frontend) (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We’ll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you’ll have the day off.

In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Tech Lead (Agent Frontend) (m/w/d):

You will take end-to-end technical ownership of the Recare Agent – our AI-native interface that orchestrates capabilities like Voice and Extract+Docs into reliable, compliant workflows for hospital environments. This is a highly visible product area where engineering decisions directly define user experience, reliability, and trust in AI-driven healthcare workflows.

  • You own the technical direction of the Recare Agent – from architecture decisions to roadmap execution and delivery predictability.

  • You lead the team as the technical backbone and escalation point, ensuring clarity, speed, and quality in execution.

  • You design and evolve the agent architecture, especially around agentic UI patterns and orchestration logic.

  • You enable the team through hands-on mentorship, code reviews, and removing blockers fast.

  • You drive reliability, performance, observability, and security across all agent workflows in a highly sensitive healthcare context.

  • You build and ship frontend systems using React and TypeScript, with a strong focus on scalable, maintainable architecture.

  • You collaborate closely with Product, Design, and QA to sharpen scope, manage trade-offs, and ensure predictable delivery.

  • You ensure production readiness through clear runbooks, stable releases, and measurable SLAs.

How we build:

We use a modern frontend stack to build and ship a highly interactive, AI-powered agent experience that must be fast, reliable, and safe in production healthcare environments.

  • React and TypeScript

  • Apollo (GraphQL proxy layer; REST-based backend services)

  • HeroUI with styled-components

  • Storybook (component-driven development)

  • Webpack 5 (with parts gradually migrating to Vite / SWC)

  • CircleCI (Jest, Cypress, visual regression testing)

  • SonarCloud (code quality & security analysis)


Here’s how we picture you as our Tech Lead (Agent Frontend) (m/w/d):

  • You bring 6+ years of professional software development experience and have led and owned technical directions team outcomes end to end.

  • You have strong expertise in TypeScript and React and are confident building complex, stateful UIs with asynchronous or streaming-driven interactions.

  • You understand how to design, ship, and evolve frontend systems in a production environment with a strong focus on quality and maintainability.

  • You bring solid foundations in CI/CD and testing frameworks (e.g. Jest, Cypress) and a clear interest in deeper engineering topics such as pipelines, caching strategies, and performance optimization.

  • You think in systems and trade-offs, and you actively drive for simple, scalable architectures while maintaining a high bar for engineering quality.

  • You take ownership naturally – you act as a reliable escalation point, ensure clarity in execution, and help the team stay unblocked and focused.

  • You communicate clearly and effectively in a remote-first environment, with strong collaboration skills across Product, Design, and QA.

  • You care about security and privacy by design and are comfortable working in a healthcare context where reliability, compliance, and trust are critical.

  • You communicate confidently in English and are comfortable operating in an international environment.

description_html:
Stellvertretender Verpackungsprofi mit Führungsstärke gesucht – Werde unser neuer stellvertretender Verpackungsleiter (m/w/d)!

Du kennst die Produktion – wir geben dir den Rahmen, sie zu führen!

Du weißt genau, was in einer Lebensmittelproduktion läuft – und was nicht laufen darf. Du hast HACCP nicht nur gehört, sondern lebst und atmest es täglich. Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. In unserer modernen Produktionshalle in Berlin-Marzahn füllen und verpacken wir täglich Speisen und Speisenkomponenten auf höchstem Hygieneniveau. Und du sorgst dafür, dass das so bleibt – und noch besser wird.

Das erwartet dich

  • Steuerung und Überwachung des gesamten Produktionsablaufs in der Abfüll- und Verpackungshalle

  • Sicherstellung und Weiterentwicklung der Hygienestandards nach HACCP-Richtlinien

  • Führung, Einteilung und Motivation des Produktionsteams im Tagesgeschäft

  • Kontrolle von Qualität, Mengen und Abläufen entlang der gesamten Produktionslinie

  • Dokumentation und Pflege produktionsrelevanter Aufzeichnungen und Prüfprotokolle

  • Identifikation und Beseitigung von Störungen sowie kontinuierliche Prozessoptimierung

  • Koordination mit angrenzenden Bereichen wie Küche, Logistik und Qualitätsmanagement

  • Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller Arbeits- und Sicherheitsvorschriften

Das bieten wir dir

  • Geregelte Arbeitszeiten – Montag bis Freitag, Vollzeit (40h/Woche), kein Wochenende

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz – eine Schlüsselrolle in einem wachsenden Unternehmen mit echter Perspektive

  • Moderne Produktionsumgebung – zertifizierte Halle auf höchstem Hygieneniveau mit aktueller Ausstattung

  • Freie Verpflegung – Frühstück, Mittagessen und Getränke inklusive

  • Dienstkleidung – wird vollständig von uns gestellt

  • Weiterbildung & Karriere – gezielte Förderung in unserer Z-Akademie

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege – familiäres Miteinander statt Konzernbürokratie

  • Kollegiales Team – ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenhalt keine Floskel ist

Dein Arbeitsort

Berlin-Marzahn, Wolfener Straße 36 – gut erreichbar per ÖPNV und mit Parkmöglichkeiten direkt vor Ort.


Das bringst du mit

  • Fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Lebensmittelproduktion, Abfüllung oder Speisenverpackung

  • Sehr gute, nachgewiesene Kenntnisse im Bereich HACCP und lebensmittelrechtliche Anforderungen

  • Erfahrung in der Führung von Produktionsteams – du weißt, wie man Menschen mitnimmt

  • Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise auch in stressigen Situationen

  • Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein für Qualität, Hygiene und Arbeitssicherheit

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Dokumentations- und Protokollierungspflichten

Noch Fragen?

Henry Kossack

Personalrecruiting

E-Mail: www.z-catering.de

description_html:
Expansion Manager – Bodywork Studios Europe (m/w/d) in Vollzeit gesucht

Standort: Hamburg, München oder Berlin

Über Soulhouse

Soulhouse ist ein schnell wachsendes Self-Care Scale-up mit der Mission, die #1 für Modern Bodywork in Europa zu werden. Wir bieten Premium Massagen, Assisted Stretching und Facework in stilvollen Studios und helfen monatlich tausenden Menschen, sich rundum wohlzufühlen. In den nächsten Jahren folgen über 100 weitere Standorte in Europa.

Deine Rolle

Über 100 Studios in europäischen Großstädten bis Dezember 2030 sind das Ziel. Allein 2027 sind über 20 neue Standorte geplant. Wohin wir wollen, wissen wir. Jetzt zählt Tempo. Jeder Standort beginnt mit einer Fläche, die jemand gefunden hat – idealerweise, bevor der Markt sie sieht. Das ist deine Rolle.

Du führst deinen Teil der Flächen-Pipeline: von der Marktabdeckung bis zum unterschriftsreifen Mietangebot. Deine persönliche Zielgröße pro Jahr: Hunderte Objekte gesichtet, 40+ besichtigt, 15+ in Verhandlung, 8–12 abgeschlossen. Standbein Deutschland, dann Europa – Mailand, Madrid, Amsterdam und mehr. Dein Fokus ist Akquisition. Planung und Ausbau liegen bei anderen im Team.

Requirements

Deine Kernaufgaben

Scannen: Volle Marktabdeckung der Zielstädte – Portale, Ausschreibungen, Lagen, Frequenzachsen.

Sourcen: Die Hälfte der Deals läuft Off-Market – dein Netzwerk zu Asset Managern, Family Offices, Projektentwicklern und Maklern.

Präsenz zeigen: Expo Real, MAPIC und weitere Branchentreffen – dort entstehen die Kontakte, aus denen Verträge werden.

Screenen: Bewertung nach Anforderungsprofil und Standortscoring – inklusive schnellem, begründetem Nein.

Besichtigen: Vor Ort Grundriss, Flächeneffizienz, Machbarkeit und Markenfit beurteilen und dokumentieren.

Entscheiden: Entscheidungsvorlage mit Wirtschaftlichkeit, Konditionen, Risiken, Empfehlung – dann das Mietangebot, abgestimmt mit Head of Expansion und CEO.

Kaltansprache: Anrufe, Mails, Vor-Ort-Termine, Messen – Routine für dich.

Pipeline-Disziplin: Kein Gespräch versandet, kein Rückruf geht unter.

Automatisierung: Ansprache, Nachfassen, Terminkoordination laufen automatisiert.

KI im Tagesgeschäft: Serien-Anschreiben, Eigentümer-Recherche, fremdsprachige Unterlagen, Entscheidungsvorlagen.

Teamsteuerung: Werkstudierende und Junior-Mitarbeitende arbeiten dir zu, du steuerst sie selbst.

Benefits

Das bieten wir dir

Ein Team, das liefert: Flache Hierarchien, direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Head of Expansion und CEO. Entscheidungen zu Objekten fallen innerhalb von 24 Stunden.

Wachstum, das man sieht: Jeder Standort, den du abschließt, steht wenig später als Premium-Studio.

Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Eigener Markt, eigenes Budget, eigene Zuarbeit.

Internationalität: Von Deutschland in Europas Metropolen – Reisen sind Teil des Jobs, nicht Ausnahme.

Attraktive Vergütung: attraktives Jahresgehalt zwishen 65.000€ -75.000€ je nach Erfahrung plus attraktive Erfolgskomponente auf abgeschlossene Standorte.

Entwicklung & Kultur: Betriebliche Weiterbildung, Firmenevents, Mitarbeiter-Rabatte und viele weitere exklusive Vorteile.

Referral Bonus: 500 € für jede erfolgreiche Empfehlung.

Mobilität & Lifestyle: Wahlweise Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft oder monatliche Shopping-Gutscheine.

Zusätzliche Vorteile: Monatliche Soulhouse-Gutscheine, Bike-Leasing-Angebot sowie exklusive Mitarbeiterkonditionen auf weitere Leistungen.

Umzug: Soulhouse bezuschusst deinen Umzug, wenn du für den Job in eine andere Stadt ziehst.

title: Technischer Senior Projektmanager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Vitagroup
description_html:
Dein Plus bei der vitagroup

  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Mobile Office
  • Möglichkeit zum Arbeiten im europäischen Ausland
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Auslandskrankenversicherung
  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, Sozialleistungen und einen leistungsabhängigen Bonus
  • JobRad: Fahrrad-Leasing zur beruflichen und privaten Nutzung
  • Attraktive MitarbeiterInnen-Rabatte
  • Offene Feedback-Kultur und individuelle Weiterbildung
  • Interdisziplinäre Aufgaben
  • Agile & digitale Unternehmensstrukturen
  • Über 20 Jahre Wissen & Erfahrung in der digitalen Gesundheitswelt
  • Mentoring & Wissensaustausch


Dafür brauchen wir Dich

  • Du übernimmst die technische Steuerung unserer Kundenprojekte von der Planung bis zur Fertigstellung und erarbeitest eigenständig erste Vorschläge zur Zielarchitektur und zum Schnittstellendesign
  • Du arbeitest nah am Kunden-remote und vor Ort-und verantwortest gemeinsam mit dem Team den Weg von der Anforderung bis zum produktiven Betrieb
  • Du förderst die Zusammenarbeit mit operativen und technischen Kundenvertretern, um Produktakzeptanz und Systemintegration zu verbessern
  • Du fungierst intern als Sprachrohr des Kunden-im engen Austausch mit Vertrieb, Produktmanagement, Entwicklung und Support
  • Du übersetzt klinische Prozesse und fachliche Anforderungen in technische Schnittstellen- und Integrationskonzepte (u.a. HL7 v2, HL7 FHIR,openEHR, DICOM)
  • Du arbeitest eng mit den Solution Architects und Technical Consultants im Team zusammen und unterstützt mit belastbaren technischen Konzepten (PoCs, Referenzlösungen)
  • Du übernimmst je nach Projektphase auch angrenzende Rollen im Team – etwa in der technischen Beratung, im Anforderungsmanagement oder in der Presales-Unterstützung
  • Du definierst gemeinsam mit den Stakeholdern Projektumfang, Ziele, Anforderungen und die zu erbringenden Leistungen
  • Du verantwortest Projektbudgets, Zeitpläne und Ressourcen sowie das Projektcontrolling und die Berichterstattung
  • Du steuerst Datenintegrationsprojekte und stellst eine reibungslose Verbindung zwischen den beteiligten Systemen sicher
  • Du identifizierst Projektrisiken, entwickelst geeignete Maßnahmen zur Risikominimierung und stellst den Projekterfolg sicher
  • Du koordinierst die Kommunikation zwischen technischen und nicht-technischen Beteiligten und informierst alle Stakeholder über den Projektfortschritt

title: Werkstudent EV Sales & Deal Operations (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Aampere
description_html:
Über Aampere

Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Wir ermöglichen es EV-Besitzer:innen, ihr Fahrzeug innerhalb von 48 Stunden zu verkaufen, und verschaffen Händlern in ganz Europa Zugang zu neuen Kundensegmenten. Der Markt ist fragmentiert, intransparent und schwer vertrauenswürdig, deshalb bauen wir die Infrastruktur, die das ändert, damit mehr Elektroautos ein zweites Leben bekommen und der Wandel zur Elektromobilität wirklich an Fahrt aufnimmt.

Und es funktioniert: Wir steigern unseren Umsatz Jahr für Jahr um das Vierfache und halten bereits mehr als 1 % des deutschen Consumer-EV-Wiederverkaufsmarkts. Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene und der Automobilwelt, mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Alasco, Porsche, Mercedes und KPMG.

Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. Wenn du etwas bewegen möchtest, dann werde Teil unseres Teams.


Deine Mission

Du hast Lust auf direkten Kundenkontakt, gehst gerne auf Menschen zu und Autos sind für dich nicht einfach nur Fortbewegungsmittel, sondern ein echtes Interesse? Dann bist du bei uns im Sales Team genau richtig. 

Operativer Vertrieb: Du unterstützt unser Sales Team dabei, Fahrzeuge für die Auktion vorzubereiten: von der Prüfung der Daten bis hin zur finalen Aufbereitung für die Plattform.
Prozessbegleitung: Du begleitest unsere Verkäufer:innen durch den gesamten Verkaufsprozess. Vom ersten telefonischen Kontakt bis zur Planung der Übergabe sorgst du dafür, dass intern alles reibungslos läuft.
Sales-Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe, bringst Ideen ein und hilfst mit, unsere Prozesse schlanker, effizienter und skalierbarer zu gestalten.
Feedback für Produkt und Team: Du gibst Erkenntnisse aus dem Kundenkontakt weiter und hilfst so, unser Produkt gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.
Startup-Alltag: Du bringst dich dort ein, wo du gebraucht wirst, mit deinen individuellen Stärken und Interessen.


Das bringst du mit

Dein Background: Du bist aktuell immatrikuliert im Bachelor- oder Masterstudium. Dein Studiengang ist für uns zweitrangig, viel wichtiger sind deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und dein Blick für saubere Prozesse.
Kommunikationsstärke: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, telefonierst gerne und fühlst dich im direkten Kundenkontakt wohl.
Interesse an Autos: Kein Muss, aber definitiv ein Plus, denn du wirst viel mit Fahrzeugdaten arbeiten.
Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du hast Lust auf ein Umfeld, in dem sich Dinge schnell bewegen, zeigst Eigeninitiative und willst aktiv mitgestalten statt nur Dienst nach Vorschrift zu leisten.
Verfügbarkeit: Du hast 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit für uns, in den Semesterferien gerne mehr.
Sprachkenntnisse: Du beherrschst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) und Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift.


Why Aampere?

Wachstum & Ownership: Du bekommst vom ersten Tag an echte Verantwortung, triffst eigene Entscheidungen und wirst als vollwertiges Teammitglied behandelt: im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du entsprechend schnell aufsteigen. Student steht auf dem Vertrag, nicht auf deiner Rolle.
Urban Sports Club oder Job Ticket: healthy team, happy team
Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats)
Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what's next?
Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im angrenzenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten: direkt neben dem Aampere-Büro und mit Blick auf das Riesenrad.
Chance auf Übernahme: Wenn du besonders gut bist, wollen wir, dass du bleibst. Denk von Anfang an nicht daran, wo das endet, sondern wo es hinführen könnte.


Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn...

...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind.
...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten.
...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren.
...du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. "Das ist nicht mein Job" kennen wir nicht. Du packst da an, wo es brennt, auch wenn es außerhalb deiner Rollenbeschreibung liegt.
...du einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job willst. Wir bauen etwas Großes und das geht nicht nebenbei. Wer hier ist, will Vollgas geben, statt nur die Zeit abzusitzen.


Wie wir arbeiten

Drei Werte, keine Poster an der Wand, sondern wie wir täglich arbeiten, einstellen und wachsen:

Aaudacity. Wir sind mutig genug, Risiken einzugehen, und schnell genug, es nicht halbherzig zu tun.
Aambition to grow. Wir wollen wachsen, als Menschen und als Unternehmen.
Aampact over Hierarchy. Die beste Idee gewinnt, egal von wem sie kommt. Titel entscheiden hier keine Diskussion.


Noch ein paar Worte zum Abschluss

Bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns über Deine formlose Bewerbung - alles weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam.

Egal, welchen Hintergrund, welche Herkunft oder welche Geschlechtsidentität du mitbringst – bei uns zählt, wer du als Person bist. Wir fördern eine Kultur des Respekts und Miteinanders, in der jede Stimme gehört wird, persönliche Weiterentwicklung möglich ist und Wertschätzung an erster Stelle steht.

title: Founding Brand Manager (m/w/d)

description_html:
Über Aampere

Werde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert.
