title: Growth Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at EDTELLIGENT
description_html:
München (präferiert) oder Remote

Baue mit uns die Weiterbildungssuche der Zukunft.

Unsere Plattform GenauMeinKurs soll Menschen dabei helfen, schneller und einfacher die Weiterbildung zu finden, die wirklich zu ihnen passt. Dafür verbinden wir eine moderne Kurssuche mit AI-basierter Nutzerqualifizierung, organischem Wachstum, Performance Marketing und Daten.

Dafür suchen wir keinen klassischen Marketing Manager. Wir suchen einen technisch starken Growth Marketer, der Reichweite und qualifizierte Leads aufbaut und wissen will, was nach dem Klick passiert. Der Muster in Daten erkennt, AI praktisch einsetzt und gemeinsam mit uns unseren B2C-Funnel kontinuierlich besser macht.

Wir entwickeln zudem intelligente Software- und Datenlösungen für den Markt der beruflichen Weiterbildung. Mit unseren Produkten unterstützen wir bereits über 100 Bildungsträger dabei, ihre Bildungsangebote effizient zu verwalten, mehr Menschen zu erreichen und erfolgreicher zu wachsen.

Mit rund 20 Kolleginnen und Kollegen bieten wir dir viel Gestaltungsspielraum und kurze Entscheidungswege. Unser Gründer- und Führungsteam bringt langjährige Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Skalierung digitaler Plattformen mit – bei uns verbindest du Startup-Geschwindigkeit mit der Möglichkeit, von einem erfahrenen, sympathischen (:)) und outcome-orientierten Team zu lernen.

Aufgaben

Drei Schwerpunkte stehen zunächst im Fokus:

  • AI-basierte Lead-Qualifizierung: Wir möchten die Nutzer bestmöglich dabei begleiten, die für die individuellen Ziele passende Weiterbildung beim passenden Anbieter zu finden. Wir glauben hierbei fest, dass AI bei dem Matching der genau passenden Weiterbildung eine zentrale Rolle spielt. Nach einer Anfrage qualifizieren wir Nutzer zudem persönlich und AI-gestützt weiter. Du analysierst Nutzerinteraktionen, erkennst Muster und verbesserst gemeinsam mit Product und Tech Prompts, Qualifizierungslogiken und User Journeys, um Lead-Qualität, Funnel und Marketing kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • SEO, Content & GEO: Mit tausenden Kursen von hunderten Bildungsanbietern haben wir ein starkes Fundament für organisches Wachstum. Du identifizierst Potenziale (Content & Tech), entwickelst skalierbare Content- und Landingpage-Ansätze und setzt AI überall dort ein, wo sie Qualität und Geschwindigkeit verbessert. Dazu gehört insbesondere auch GEO (Generative Engine Optimization).
  • Performance Marketing: Unsere Paid-Aktivitäten steuern wir gemeinsam mit einer spezialisierten Agentur. Du übernimmst mit die Verantwortung auf unserer Seite, setzt Ziele und KPIs, bringst unsere Daten zur Lead-Qualität in die Kampagnensteuerung ein und monitorst Kampagnen, Keywords und Landingpages und Conversions. Du musst nicht täglich selbst im Ads-Konto sitzen – aber gut genug verstehen, was dort passiert, um die richtigen Entscheidungen zu treffen und perspektivisch weitere Paid-Kanäle zu erschließen.

Mit der Zeit kommen weitere Themen dazu: Conversion-Optimierung, Lifecycle Management in HubSpot, Paid Social sowie AI-basierte Automatisierung und agentische Workflows.

Qualifikation

Uns ist weniger wichtig, wie viele Jahre Berufserfahrung du hast oder ob du bereits jede einzelne Aufgabe gemacht hast. Entscheidend ist, wie du denkst, lernst und Dinge vorantreibst und ein maximalen Fokus auf die Interessen unserer User setzt.

Wenn eine Kampagne oder Maßnahme viele Leads liefert, willst du wissen, ob es auch die richtigen sind. Wenn die Conversion sinkt, schaust du auf den gesamten Funnel. Wenn wir im Index sinken interessiert es Dich warum. Und wenn du etwas noch nicht kannst, findest du heraus, wie es funktioniert.

  • Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in Growth, Performance oder Digital Marketing mit und hast in mindestens einem unserer Kernbereiche – SEO, SEA/Paid, CRO oder Marketing Automation – bereits hands-on gearbeitet.
  • LLMs sind für Dich fester Bestandteil Deines Arbeitsalltags. Prompts, APIs und Automatisierung findest du spannend – auch wenn Du selbst kein Developer bist.
  • Du denkst analytisch und hast ein gutes Verständnis für Funnels, Tracking und Performance-KPIs und hast keine Probleme damit, eng mit Product & Tech zusammenzuarbeiten.
  • Du bist technisch neugierig und arbeitest selbstverständlich mit AI-Tools.
  • Du lernst schnell, arbeitest eigenständig und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse.

Ein Plus, kein Muss: Erfahrung mit Claude (Code), Chat GPT, Gemini, Google Ads, HubSpot, GA4, Search Console, Meta Ads, Looker Studio, SQL, n8n/Make oder vergleichbaren Tools.

Benefits

  • 🚀 Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an.
  • 🤖 AI als echter Bestandteil von Marketing, Qualifizierung und Customer Journey.
  • 📊 Daten vom ersten Klick bis zur tatsächlichen Conversion.
  • 🧪 Freiheit, neue Ansätze schnell zu testen und erfolgreiche Ideen zu skalieren.
  • 💡 Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit einem erfahrenen Gründer- und Führungsteam, Product, Tech, Sales und Customer Success.
  • 🏡 Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub sowie die Wahl zwischen unserem Büro in München-Giesing und Remote Work.
  • 📈 Die Möglichkeit, Growth Marketing bei uns maßgeblich mit aufzubauen.
  • 🛠️ Ein modernes Toolset mit Google Workspace, Slack, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, HubSpot, Make und weiteren Tools.

So läuft der Prozess

  • Kennenlernen: 30 Minuten mit unserer Recruiterin – über dich, die Rolle, gegenseitige Erwartungen und die wichtigsten Rahmenbedingungen.
  • Fachgespräch: Wir gehen gemeinsam durch einen echten Fall aus unserem Growth-Funnel und diskutieren, wie du an das Thema herangehen würdest. Keine Case Study, keine Hausaufgabe über Nacht.
  • Team kennenlernen: Im Büro oder per Video lernst du weitere Kolleginnen und Kollegen kennen. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, folgen zeitnah Entscheidung und Angebot.

Wir halten das Tempo hoch: Du bekommst schnell Feedback und wir schließen den gesamten Prozess innerhalb weniger Wochen ab.

Klingt spannend?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil.

Noch spannender als perfekte Stationen finden wir, was du selbst aufgebaut, optimiert oder herausgefunden hast – egal ob SEO-Projekt, Kampagne, Funnel, Automation oder AI-Experiment.

title: Service Project Management Intern
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Backmarket
description_html:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

The Extended services team at Back Market is responsible for creating, developing and rolling out new innovative services and cool features for our end-customers all over the world. Within this department, the Team is supporting the business by ensuring that our offers answer our customers needs while being the best-in-class in terms of operational excellence.

As a Services Project Manager Intern, you will work within the Extended Services Team. You will improve customers’ funnel/claim journey, launch new added-value features/service and make sure our current offer meets local customers' expectations and requirements.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Monitor the performance of active countries (revenue & customer experience) on Tableau & create reports and share suggestions of weekly action plans

  • Improve the NPS and the claim management process along with the Care Team to provide the best in class customer experience

  • Launch new features to our insurance offer to ensure our offer is cooler than Apple Care.

  • Ensure our current offer meets local customers’ expectations & requirements (cross-team work with marketing & product teams and handle relations with local partners).

  • Roll out new services or new pricing (cross-team work with Country managers, legal teams, product, etc)

  • Work on the new range of Business-to-Customer premium services to increase customer conversion and loyalty

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • Looking for a 6-month internship

  • English AND French are no-brainers (fully professional capability). If you’re extra cool and speak more languages, bonus points for you!

  • Strong analytical skills (Pack Office - Excel and PowerPoint skills). SQL is a strong plus, but not mandatory.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills (communication skills and data-driven)

  • You are proactive, have team spirit, and a high capacity to federate and work with transversal teams

  • Experience in fintech or insurtech is a plus, but not mandatory

ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP: ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: 6 months

  • Schedule: Full-time (35H/week)

  • Location: Paris, France

  • Contract: Internship agreement from your French school required

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Skills fit interview with the direct manager

  • Technical test (home assignment)

  • Cultural fit interview with another person in the team

Back Market is on a mission to make refurbished tech the new norm. To achieve this, we use data to better understand our customers, improve their experience, and make smarter product and business decisions.

Within the Data Division, the Customer Experience Analytics team supports teams working across the customer journey, CRM, and Services. We help the business understand customer behaviors, identify opportunities to improve the experience, and measure the impact of new initiatives.

As a Customer Journey & App Analytics Apprentice, you will primarily support the Customer Journey and App Analytics scope. You will work closely with Product, Tech, UX, and Business teams to analyze customer behavior, support experimentation, and turn data into actionable insights.

  • You are interested in mobile app analytics and want to understand how users interact with digital products

  • You are comfortable working with data from different sources and are attentive to data quality and consistency

  • You can turn complex analysis into clear insights and practical recommendations

  • You communicate clearly in written and spoken English

  • You are curious, rigorous, organized, and willing to ask questions

  • You are autonomous and comfortable collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • You enjoy working in a fast-paced, international, and collaborative environment

description_html:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Affiliate Manager (AI Product) based in France.

The Affiliate Manager will manage and scale an existing network of affiliate partners across multiple commercial models.
You will own partner onboarding, technical setup, performance monitoring, optimization, and ongoing relationship management.
The role combines commercial partnership management with hands-on expertise in tracking, attribution, analytics, and traffic quality.
You will use performance data to identify opportunities, improve underperforming placements, and support sustainable partner growth.
Working closely with Business Development, you will help launch new partnerships and ensure they are technically configured and performing effectively.
You will also maintain accurate partner and reporting infrastructure while investigating discrepancies and emerging performance issues.
This is an international, remote role suited to an analytical and technically confident professional working in a fast-moving AI product environment.


Accountabilities:
  • Manage and scale an existing affiliate partner portfolio across CPA, RevShare, and Hybrid commercial models.
  • Handle the full partner lifecycle, including onboarding, creative selection, landing page setup, tracking configuration, quality assurance, and ongoing optimization.
  • Monitor daily and weekly partner KPIs, including traffic quality, conversion rates, CPA, ROI, and placement performance.
  • Identify underperforming traffic and work directly with partners to implement optimization strategies and improve results.
  • Maintain tracking and reporting infrastructure, including postback/S2S configurations, and investigate discrepancies between partner and internal statistics.
  • Keep the affiliate partner database accurate and up to date, including contacts, commercial terms, geographic coverage, status, and next steps.
  • Support Business Development with the launch and scaling of new custom partnerships once commercial terms have been established.
  • Manage technical setup, initial monitoring, and early-stage optimization for newly launched partnerships.
  • Monitor competitor affiliate programs and share relevant market insights and opportunities with the wider team.
  • Maintain strong partner communication and ensure affiliate activities align with applicable advertising platform requirements.

    • Requirements:

    • At least 2 years of experience in full-cycle affiliate account management, including partner onboarding, creative and landing page setup, tracking implementation, and scaling.
    • Strong understanding of CPA, CPL, CPS, RevShare, and Hybrid models, as well as affiliate channel economics, traffic quality, and fraud risks.
    • Technical literacy in tracking technologies, pixels, postbacks, server-to-server (S2S) tracking, attribution, and basic API usage.
    • Experience managing partner pipelines, CRM systems, and affiliate databases with strong attention to data accuracy and organization.
    • Analytical skills with the ability to build and interpret performance dashboards, identify anomalies, and turn data into optimization decisions.
    • Understanding of advertising platform compliance requirements and best practices.
    • Confident use of AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT for research, analysis, communication, and daily workflow support.
    • Strong business English skills, both written and verbal, with confidence communicating with international partners and leading partner calls.
    • Comfortable working independently, managing multiple partners and priorities, and taking ownership of performance outcomes.
    • Strong communication, relationship-building, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote work with the opportunity to work from anywhere.
      • International environment with collaboration across multiple markets and regions.
      • Opportunity to manage and scale affiliate partnerships for an AI-focused product.
      • Hands-on exposure to performance marketing, attribution, tracking, and partnership growth.
      • Opportunity to work with CPA, RevShare, and Hybrid affiliate models.
      • Close collaboration with Business Development and other commercial teams.
      • Opportunity to contribute to new partnership launches and optimization strategies.
      • Initial pay level or salary range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins.
      • Full-time position with opportunities to develop expertise in affiliate marketing, analytics, and AI-enabled workflows.

description_html:
Job summary (Short promotional text)

We are looking for a Senior Consultant to strengthen our European Grants team in France.

You will advise innovative companies and organisations on European funding strategies and lead the development of complex grant applications for major R&D, industrial and innovation projects.

The role combines strategic consulting, project analysis, proposal writing and client management. We are looking for someone who can independently transform complex projects into compelling funding strategies and high quality European proposals.


Your mission (What are you going to do in text) summarised down below

Help ambitious organisations secure European funding for high impact innovation projects by combining strategic advice, technical understanding and excellent proposal development.


Your tasks 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Lead the development of complex European funding applications under programmes such as Horizon Europe, Innovation Fund, LIFE and CEF.
  • Assess R&D and innovation projects, identify the most appropriate funding opportunities and advise clients on funding strategy.
  • Structure compelling project narratives covering excellence, innovation, impact, implementation and European added value.
  • Interview senior client stakeholders, scientists, engineers and technical experts to extract and challenge the information required for successful proposals.


Your tasks 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Coordinate the complete proposal development process, including work plans, consortium inputs, budgets, deadlines and quality reviews.
  • Manage client relationships independently and act as a trusted advisor throughout the funding process.
  • Review and improve proposals prepared by other consultants and contribute to internal quality standards and methodologies.
  • Support the development of junior consultants and contribute to business development and the growth of PNO Innovation’s European Grants activities in France.


Your profile 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Master’s degree or PhD in a scientific, engineering, technical, economic or innovation related discipline.
  • Several years of relevant experience in European funding, innovation consulting, R&D project development or a closely related environment.
  • Proven experience with European funding programmes, ideally including Horizon Europe and/or other major programmes such as Innovation Fund, LIFE or CEF. Demonstrated experience writing or leading high quality grant proposals.
  • Excellent written and spoken French and English.


Your Profile 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Strong ability to understand complex scientific, technological and business concepts and turn them into persuasive narratives.
  • Strong client management, communication and project management skills.
  • Autonomous, rigorous and comfortable managing complex assignments under demanding deadlines.
  • Ability to mentor less experienced consultants and contribute to the development of the team.


Why us? (What do we offer) 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Lead major European funding projects with innovative companies and organisations.
  • Work across technologies, sectors and European programmes rather than being limited to a single funding instrument.
  • Join one of Europe’s largest specialist innovation and funding consultancies.
  • Work with an international network of more than 600 colleagues and European funding specialists.


Why us? (What do we offer) 2nd part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Take ownership of client relationships and complex strategic assignments.
  • Contribute to developing junior consultants and strengthening our European Grants practice in France.
  • Benefit from clear opportunities for professional development and increasing responsibility.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package according to experience and seniority.

description_html:
Rejoignez notre transformation !

 

TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

 

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

 

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes possédant une RQTH en cours de validité.

 

Vos missions :

 

Gestion administrative du personnel :

  •          Gérer les entrées et sorties : contrats de travail, avenants, attestations.

  •          Suivre les périodes d’essai, absences, congés, arrêts maladie.

  •          Assurer la mise à jour des dossiers individuels des salariés.

  •          Préparer les documents nécessaires à la vie du contrat (médecine du travail, formation, disciplinaire)

Gestion des disciplinaires :

  •          Conseiller et accompagner les managers dans la gestion des situations disciplinaires (avertissements, convocations, sanctions).

  •          Rédiger les courriers disciplinaires et suivre les procédures associées.

  •          Veiller au respect du droit du travail et de la convention collective du transport.

 

Accompagnement des managers et des équipes:

  •          Accompagner les collaborateurs dans leurs démarches RH et leur parcours professionnel.

  •          Contribuer à la prévention des conflits et à l’amélioration du climat social.

 

Communication Interne :

  •          Participer à l'élaboration et à la diffusion des supports de communication interne (intranet).

title: Senior People Ops Manager (International)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Photoroom
description_html:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

  • French and USA payroll and entity obligations

  • European employees through an EOR setup

  • Growing Paris and New York offices

  • Multiple benefits providers and external partners

  • An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees.

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

What you will own

Payroll

  • Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

  • Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

Compliance

  • Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

  • Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

  • Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

  • Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

Contracts and People documentation

  • Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

  • Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

  • Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

Employee lifecycle

  • Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

  • Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

  • Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

  • Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

Benefits & Compensation

  • Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

  • Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions

  • Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance

HRIS, data and automation

Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems.

This includes:

  • HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality

  • Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

  • Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

  • Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

What we are looking for

You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees.

In particular, we are looking for:

  • Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance

  • Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls

  • HRIS experience. Hibob is a plus, but experience configuring and improving a comparable system matters more

  • A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation

  • Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice

  • High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through

  • Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French

  • Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week.

The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work remotely, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

title: Chef(fe) de projet déploiement solution SAAS
description_html:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense.

Vous serez amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale.

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Pour accompagner le développement de nos projets et répondre aux besoins de nos clients, nous renforçons notre équipe Consulting. Nous recherchons un(e) Chef(fe) de projet déploiement pour piloter l’implémentation de la solution Vertical Expense chez nos clients, en collaboration avec les équipes internes (technique, produit, CSM) et les interlocuteurs client (DSI, DAF, DRH, métiers).

Tu interviendras au cœur des projets, de la compréhension des besoins, au paramétrage de la solution, en passant par l’accompagnement des utilisateurs.

Tes responsabilités :

  • Piloter les projets de déploiement de A à Z, du cadrage à la mise en production.

  • Analyser les besoins des clients et les conseiller sur l’optimisation de leurs processus.

  • Animer les ateliers projet et assurer la coordination des différentes parties prenantes.

  • Rédiger et faire valider les spécifications fonctionnelles et les livrables projet.

  • Organiser et réaliser le paramétrage de la solution selon les règles métier du client.

  • Accompagner les intégrations techniques (connecteurs ERP/SIRH, SSO, API…)

  • Assurer les phases de tests, recettes, formations, et transfert vers les équipes support.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de nos processus de delivery.

  • Être un relais actif du retour client vers les équipes produit.

  • Assurer le suivi des projets et garantir la satisfaction client.


Ce qu’on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu as une expérience réussie en tant que chef(fe) de projet fonctionnel ou consultant(e) fonctionnel(le) dans le cadre d’un projet de déploiement (Solutions Finance, RH, ERP ou SIRH... est un plus).

  • Tu maîtrises les bases de données et SQL, et tu comprends les environnements web, API, SSO et formats d’échange.

  • Tu possèdes un bon niveau fonctionnel, notamment sur les sujets de comptabilité, frais professionnels et processus métier.

  • Tu es à l’aise dans les projets multi-interlocuteurs et sais adopter une posture de conseil fonctionnel auprès des clients.

  • Tu es organisé(e), rigoureux(se), réactif(ve) et communiques avec aisance à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Rejoindre une entreprise en croissance, avec une base clients qui se développe et des contextes d’utilisation variés.

  • Évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, où ton expertise et tes actions auront un impact concret sur la réussite des projets et la satisfaction client.

  • Travailler autour d’un produit reconnu et apprécié par ses clients.

  • Rejoindre une équipe expérimentée et bienveillante, favorisant le partage de connaissances, tout en développant ton expertise fonctionnelle grâce à des missions variées et un rôle clé dans l’accompagnement de nos clients.

Processus de recrutement

description_html:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte
 
La squad Productivity est au cœur de la transformation produit autour de la gestion des affaires contentieuses de bout en bout.
Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi, au-delà du seul gain de productivité, en allant vers l'accompagnement de la réflexion et de l'argumentation juridique, à travers plusieurs langues.
 
Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur :
1. Analyse de documents
2. Rédaction automatisée des conclusions et documents juridiques
3. Réflexion stratégique sur l’argumentation
 
C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1.
 
Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !
 
A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)

Les missions 🛠
  • Concevoir et développer des features produit de bout en bout — de la modélisation back-end à l'interface utilisateur, en ownership complet sur tes sujets.
  • Intégrer des modèles d'IA et LLM dans les flux produit — pour enrichir l'expérience des avocats et juristes qui utilisent Doctrine au quotidien.
  • Maintenir et faire évoluer notre architecture cloud — stack moderne, scalabilité, fiabilité des services en production.
  • Participer activement aux choix techniques de ta squad — revues de code, décisions d'architecture, amélioration continue de la qualité du code.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit et Design — pour transformer des problèmes métier complexes en solutions techniques concrètes et utiles.
  • Contribuer à la roadmap technique transverse — outillage, dette technique, documentation, et montée en compétences collective.

    • Le profil idéal 👀
  • Tu maîtrises TypeScript/JavaScript côté back et front, et tu es à l'aise sur une stack moderne en production (Node.js, React ou équivalent).
  • Tu as une vraie culture backend — modélisation de données, APIs robustes, performance, gestion de la dette technique. Le front ne te fait pas peur, mais c'est le back qui te définit.
  • Tu es autonome et orienté ownership — tu prends un sujet, tu le cadres, tu le livres. Tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire.
  • Tu travailles bien avec le Produit — tu comprends le besoin utilisateur, tu sais challenger un spec, et tu penses impact avant technologie.
  • Tu as une appétence pour l'IA — tu n'es pas forcément expert LLM, mais tu t'y intéresses activement et tu vois comment ça transforme les produits.
  • Tu aimes partager et faire grandir les autres — revues de code constructives, documentation, pair programming. Tu laisses la codebase meilleure qu'à ton arrivée.

    • Les à côtés du poste 👁
  • Comme tous les ingénieurs de Doctrine, tu participeras à un de nos chapters transverse, en l’espèce le chapter Web. Au sein de ce chapter, tu contribueras à des projets internes pour améliorer nos process et notre vision long-terme. Le chapter se réunit toutes les semaines pour :
  • 🤝 Partager des connaissances : suivit de l’état de l’art, revue de papiers scientifiques, amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques,…
  • 🎯 Proposer des évolutions : nouveaux outils à expérimenter, nouveaux process à mettre en œuvre
    •  
  • Tu participeras également au 👩‍💻 recrutement : tous les contributeurs individuels rencontrent des candidats à l’occasion de tests techniques ou d’entretiens.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
    (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)
     
     
    Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater !
    Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.
    Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !
     
    Diversité & inclusion
    Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement.
    Nous nous engageons à mettre en place tous les aménagements nécessaires pour garantir un environnement de travail adapté a chacun et chacune

description_html:
About the Team

We are hiring a Partnerships Manager based in France with primary responsibility for the French market. You will own some of OpenAI’s most important business development and partnerships while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities. The role is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing partnership strategies that accelerate adoption of OpenAI’s products across enterprise, developer, and consumer channels.

About the Role

You will manage relationships with strategic partners in France and on cross-border opportunities, ranging from global technology platforms to regional champions, including enterprise software vendors, telcos, cloud providers, and government-aligned organizations. This is a deeply cross-functional role requiring close collaboration with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, and Policy teams. Although the role has clear accountability for France, team priorities may evolve, so you must be ready to take on other markets, verticals, or partnership types.

Please note, this role is based in Paris with 3 days per week required in the office.

In this role, you will:

  • Own partnership strategy and execution for France, driving end-to-end partnership development and delivery in the market while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities

  • Negotiate and close strategic local and cross-border deals across commercial terms, product scope, data/privacy, brand/marketing, incentives, and expansion paths.

  • Lead senior partner relationships: build trust, align on joint value props, and manage complexity.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, Policy, and regional counterparts to align roadmaps, navigate constraints, and execute partnership initiatives.

  • Bring deep knowledge of France and a strong point of view on country and sub-region differences across EMEA, informing prioritization, positioning, and partner selection. Apply that judgment flexibly when supporting opportunities beyond France or in new verticals.

  • Define success metrics and use analytical judgment to assess progress, surface risks, and communicate outcomes to internal stakeholders.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, product partnerships, business development, or general management within the technology industry.

  • Fluency in English and French

  • Demonstrated success leading high-impact local and international partnerships involving major technology partners, including complex cross-border work.

  • Deep understanding of France, combined with experience operating across multiple countries and international markets.

  • Product-savvy with the ability to engage technical stakeholders credibly and influence product direction and roadmap tradeoffs.

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and executive presence

  • Strong analytical instincts and comfort using data to inform decisions and communicate impact

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly ambiguous environment, operate both independently and collaboratively, and adapt quickly across changing markets, verticals, and partnership types

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy

title: Manager, Account Management, SME & Growth, France
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Airwallex
description_html:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

The opportunity

We are looking for a Manager, Account Management, France to lead and develop a team of four Account Managers responsible for retaining, supporting and expanding Airwallex’s French customer base.

This is a highly hands-on player-coach role. You will own the team’s post-sale operating model across Onboard, Adopt, Prove Value and Expand, while remaining directly involved in strategic accounts, customer escalations, onboarding quality and expansion opportunities.

You will work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations to improve customer outcomes and make Airwallex easier to adopt and grow in France.

What you’ll do

Lead and coach the team

  • Manage and develop four Account Managers through focused 1:1s, account reviews, call coaching and development plans.

  • Set clear standards for account planning, stakeholder coverage, customer communication, CRM hygiene and commercial execution.

  • Improve individual performance through real customer situations, not activity reporting alone.

  • Build a team that can operate with increasing autonomy and consistent judgement.

Own customer outcomes and portfolio strategy

  • Segment the portfolio by customer value, complexity, risk and expansion potential.

  • Define the right coverage model: high-touch for strategic and high-potential accounts, more scaled motions for lower-complexity accounts.

  • Ensure priority customers have clear success outcomes, stakeholder maps, adoption plans and expansion hypotheses.

  • Improve the leading indicators of NRR: onboarding progress, time-to-value, product adoption, stakeholder coverage, customer health and expansion pipeline.

  • Improve the lagging outcomes: retention, GRR, NRR, satisfaction and advocacy.

Drive expansion and account growth

  • Build a repeatable, customer-led expansion motion across accounts, payments, FX, cards, Spend, payouts and related products.

  • Ensure expansion is based on validated customer needs, business triggers and demonstrated value—not product pitching alone.

  • Personally support strategic renewals, upsells, cross-sells and executive customer conversations.

  • Partner with Sales on handovers, pre-sales support and opportunities requiring specialist or new-business involvement.

Build the operating system

  • Create practical playbooks for onboarding, adoption, customer health, level 2 support, renewal and expansion.

  • Establish weekly reviews for risks, strategic accounts, escalations and expansion opportunities.

  • Improve visibility and predictability through clear CRM standards, account plans, health reviews and forecasting.

  • Build a closed-loop Voice of Customer process with Product, Operations, KYC, Risk and Support.

  • Turn recurring customer friction into process improvements rather than repeated individual escalations.

Orchestrate complex customer issues

  • Own the customer-facing coordination of important level 2 issues involving Support, KYC, Risk, Product or Operations.

  • Structure escalations with clear context, business impact, owner, next step and customer communication.

  • Influence internal teams to find workable solutions without bypassing controls or making unsupported commitments.

This role owns customer outcomes and orchestration. It is not a support queue-management role, and it does not replace the specialised ownership of Support, KYC, Risk or Compliance.

What success looks like

Within 90 days, you have mapped the portfolios, priority accounts, risks and expansion opportunities; established the team cadence; and created visibility on the main customer and operational issues.

Within 6–12 months:

  • priority accounts have clear plans, stakeholder coverage and next-best actions;

  • onboarding, adoption, escalation and expansion playbooks are consistently used;

  • leading indicators such as time-to-value, adoption, health coverage and expansion pipeline improve;

  • GRR, NRR, customer satisfaction and retention improve against an agreed baseline;

  • recurring customer issues are reduced through better processes and cross-functional ownership;

  • the four Account Managers show stronger autonomy, commercial judgement and consistency.

Who you are

  • 5+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Expansion or a related B2B commercial role.

  • 2+ years of direct people management, ideally leading a team of 3–8.

  • Proven ownership of retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, customer health or comparable outcomes.

  • Experience working with NRR, GRR, churn, expansion, adoption, time-to-value or customer satisfaction metrics.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, banking, FX, spend management, ERP or another complex operational environment.

  • Strong customer-facing experience with Finance, Operations, Treasury, Procurement, E-commerce, founders or senior executives.

  • Evidence of building or improving customer processes, playbooks, account segmentation, health reviews, handovers or escalation routines.

  • Ability to influence Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations without direct authority.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

  • Strong commercial judgement, ownership and comfort working in ambiguity.

Preferred experience

  • Payments, fintech, banking, FX, cards, spend management or financial infrastructure.

  • KYC, AML, Risk, Compliance or regulated customer operations.

  • Strategic or multi-entity customers across France and international markets.

  • Pre-sales, onboarding design or solution development.

  • Travel, E-commerce, SaaS, Technology or Professional Services.

The profile we are looking for

You are a hands-on manager who enjoys customer conversations, coaches through real situations and creates structure where processes are not yet mature. You combine customer empathy with commercial discipline, solve root causes rather than simply escalating issues, and turn customer insight into better team performance and repeatable growth.

This is not a pure support-management role, a purely strategic Customer Success role or a passive relationship-management position.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Account Management Lead - Editions France
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Deliveroo
description_html:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editions Strategy & Growth

    • Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site

    • Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets

    • Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums

    • Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)

    • Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites

  • Occupancy & Commercial Performance

    • Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines

    • Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team

    • Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest

    • Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale

  • P&L Ownership & Governance

    • Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter

    • Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics

    • Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results

  • Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution

  • Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens

  • Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one

  • Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops

  • Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale

  • Senior Stakeholder Management

    • Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events

    • Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins

    • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends

  • Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network

 

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • 7+ years working in commercially focused roles

  • Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams

  • Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience

  • Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time

  • Mix of both strategy and execution experience

  • Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators

  • Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams

  • Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email

  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations

  • You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)

  • Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable

  • Fluent in French and English is required

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Account Manager - Groceries & Retail
description_html:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d'un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

En tant qu'Account Manager, vous serez responsable du succès de votre portefeuille de comptes, afin d'assurer une expérience magique à nos utilisateurs, tout en construisant un socle solide et durable pour notre application.

 

MISSIONS :

  • Votre objectif sera de créer un partenariat privilégié, durable en apportant votre expertise marketplace, foodtech et account management.

  • Vous aurez comme missions principales la gestion et l'optimisation de la croissance et la profitabilité d'un portefeuille de partenaires et le respect des objectifs fixés (opérationnels et commerciaux, ventes de services)

  • Vous développerez des joint business plans avec les principaux acteurs de votre portefeuille en vous appuyant sur des routines (price, range, roll out, ops, tech review) pour faire croître le partenariat des comptes de votre équipe.

  • Vous serez en charge du déploiement et de l'expansion de votre portefeuille ainsi que des différentes campagnes Marketing que vous devrez négocier dans le cadre du "joint business plan".

  • Analyse quotidienne de la data de la performance des marques et de nos opérations Deliveroo pour identifier les causes des problèmes et améliorer constamment le niveau de service.

  • Optimisation et gestion de processus : Deliveroo est une société qui évolue à grande vitesse et à grande échelle. Vous aurez l'opportunité de créer et améliorer des processus, par exemple la gestion de partenariats pour contribuer à la croissance. Vous élaborerez des outils et des guides de meilleures pratiques pour des comptes spécifiques et pour l'ensemble du portefeuille.

  • Vous veillerez au suivi du respect des engagements contractuels pris avec les partenaires de votre portefeuille.

 

PROFIL :

  • 3 à 6 ans d'expérience d'account management ou de commercial. Une expérience chez une grande enseigne de la grande distribution serait un vrai plus.

  • Commercial: vous savez négocier, anticiper des discussions commerciales, entreprendre des actions afin de maintenir un portefeuille de qualité (discussions contractuelles, négociations de mise en place d'outils commerciaux, etc)

  • Stratégique: vous savez prendre du recul, comprendre des problématiques non structurées et proposer des solutions via des plans d'actions et un suivi de résultats

  • Analytique: capable d'être synthétique, d'approfondir les données et de comprendre les données qui permettent d'améliorer les performances pour nos partenaires en magasins

  • Proactif(-ive): vous adorez être sur le terrain et vous êtes impliqué(e) dans tout ce qui est opérationnel dans votre périmètre.

  • Centré(e) sur le client: être obsédé par nos clients. Utiliser des données quantitatives et qualitatives pour construire un service qui soit opérationnellement excellent pour nos clients.

  • Français et Anglais courant indispensables

 

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l'article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité professionnelle, l'emploi des personnes en situation de handicap. Deliveroo France valorise la diversité sans discrimination de genre, race, sexualité, religion ou préférences personnelles. Avec un score de 98/100 à l'Indice de l'Égalité Hommes-Femmes 2024, nous sommes engagés envers l'égalité des chances. Rejoignez-nous avec votre passion pour la nourriture dans une entreprise en pleine croissance.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Lead Software Engineer - Performance Marketing

description_html:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

 


Team

Our Growth team is a transversal entity aiming to maximize and deliver the potential of any mobile product. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech across various types of games and consumer apps.

 

Role

Voodoo is looking for a Lead Software Engineer for our Playable Ads team as part of our Central Growth Team. In this role, you'll lead key initiatives developed by our playable ads team, while staying hands-on with production and driving innovation in our playable ad formats across games.

 

Key tasks

  • Lead and coach a small team of playable ads developers/strategists embedded within franchise-dedicated squads, ensuring high autonomy and strong performance

  • Stay hands-on with playable ad production, contributing directly to the creation and iteration of high-quality playable creatives

  • Oversee operational topics for the playable team, including workflows, tooling, and best practices

  • Drive innovation in playable ad formats, constantly exploring new mechanics, interactions, and creative concepts to stay ahead of market trends

  • Collaborate closely with the Growth Manager and creative strategists to align on priorities and franchise-level objectives

  • Benchmark competitor playable ads and analyze performance data to improve production quality and effectiveness

  • Act as a technical and/or strategic reference for the team, providing guidance on both development and marketing performance topics

  • Support the rollout of playable ads across multiple game franchises, adapting formats to each title's creative strategy

  • Contribute to defining and evolving the playable ads chapter's vision, standards, and processes


Profile

  • 4+ years of experience in playable ad or game development

  • Hands-on, maker mindset - you're comfortable getting into production yourself while also stepping back to coordinate

  • Experience with relevant playable ads development tools or frameworks Unity (Luna), Cocos Creator or other relevant platforms

  • Knowledge of object-oriented programming and web game development

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and asset generation (Scenario, Flux, ElevenLabs)

  • Solid understanding of mobile marketing performance metrics and creative testing

  • Proven ability to mentor and coach peers

  • You have entrepreneurial mindset and can adapt to a high-paced environment

  • You can demonstrate excellent teamwork and collaboration skills

  • You are fluent in English (fluency in French is a plus)

 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary upon experience

  • Swile restaurant lunch voucher

  • Gymlib sports subscription (100% taken in charge by us)

  • Sidecare healthcare coverage for your family

  • Child day care facilities (Les Petits Chaperons rouge)

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

  • Creative hackathon

  • Unlimited vacation policy

  • Full stack desk and computer equipment upon your request

  • Cooperate within a globally diverse team and a rich cross-cultural work environment

Team

We work with playable developers and coordinators that turn a game into an HTML interactive ad experience. Your main mission will be to produce high-performing ads by creating and uploading them to our various ad networks.

Role

We are looking for talented individuals interested in creating playable ads that let users try our games! To succeed in this role, you need extensive Unity development experience with a past of creating unique user experiences for a global audience. You will be converting existing games into playable ads and collaborating on the creation of tools for other interactive ad formats.

  • Transform existing games into interactive user experiences

  • Optimize playable ads for the best user experience, scalability, and adaptability

  • Integrate an analytics solution to measure interactions and gain insights to offer the best user experience

  • Build interactive playable templates that can be customized by graphic designers

  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives (e.g. testing new tools, implementing new processes, etc.)

  • Develop a deep understanding of how your creations perform and why

  • Work within a small creative squad with amazing people from diverse backgrounds and nationalities

  • Have the opportunity to cover different product scopes (e.g., hypercasual, casual, consumer apps, etc.)

  • Become a creative expert in mobile gaming: benchmark what our competitors are doing, experiment with new ideas

Profile

  • Fully proficient in playable ad creation or in developing Unity projects (size optimized to be used as playable)

  • Experience creating playable ads in Unity (Luna), Cocos Creator or any relevant platform

  • Adequate knowledge of object-oriented programming and web game development

  • Proactive problem diagnosis and creative problem-solving skills

  • Fluent in English, both oral and written

  • 3+ years of experience in a similar role

  • Deeply familiar with the mobile gaming market, in particular, hyper casual and casual games

  • Creative mindset and knowledge in game design

  • Familiarity with 3rd party SDKs, analytics, and A/B testing in mobile games (preferred but not essential)

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and asset generation (Scenario, Flux, ElevenLabs)

Benefits

Competitive salary and other benefits according to the country you reside in.

Full remote for candidates based abroad, with relocation to Paris subject to discussion. Hybrid for candidates based in France.

title: Enterprise Sales Lead (French market)
