description_html:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end: you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition: We have just passed the one million member milestone – and this is only the beginning! We’re accelerating acquisition in France and doubling down on our portfolio — and the Enterprise segment is one of the core pillars of that plan.

About the Enterprise segment

  • Perimeter: companies of 3000+ employees

  • Verticals: all Verticals (Tech, Retail, Industrial Companies etc)

  • Total Addressable Market: ~7M members in France

Why Enterprise Sales is exciting at Alan

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers, Unions, long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise Account Executives.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of the Enterprise Sales team in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and scaling the machine.

More precisely, you will:

  • Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment.

  • Lead & coach a team of 4 Account Executives (and likely more to come)

    • Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment.

    • Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow‑up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution, and pipeline management.

    • Be on the field with the team: prospecting, joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the team: Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: strong feedback culture, coaching, clear ownership, and autonomy.

  • Ensure market fit and remove blockers: Surface customer expectations, patterns, and blockers, and ensure they’re addressed through the right strategic and execution plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? You may be a great fit at Alan if you... ⭐

  • Have at least 10 years experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

  • Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction, and help people grow

  • Have full working proficiency in French, and advanced level in English for internal communication

  • Have a very hands‑on mentality: you love being on the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations, and sharing what works

  • Have experience selling to Enterprise level companies (3000+ employees and above) in multi‑stakeholder deals

  • Are comfortable operating in fast‑paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

  • Are data‑driven and analytical: you know how to leverage KPIs to drive performance, run analyses, and make decisions

  • Have strong cross‑functional collaboration skills and appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

  • Are based (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience selling to HR or Finance

.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

Unions and social partners play a central and legitimate role in how social protection is designed, negotiated and implemented in France. We're looking for a Union Relations Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with unions, their federations, and the broader paritariste ecosystem, making Alan a trusted, substantive and well-known interlocutor of French social partners, and supporting our Enterprise & Public Sector teams across large private employers and public institutions.


⭐ What makes this role genuinely unique

  • You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health tech companies builds its relationships with the French social partner ecosystem (from confederations to sector federations to paritariste institutions).

  • You'll operate at the highest levels of the paritariste ecosystem: confederal leadership, sector federations, IP boards, organisations patronales.

  • You'll work directly with Founders, Public Affair as well as Public Sector and Enterprise leadership.

  • Share Alan’s content with social partners to help them assess Alan on its merits and form their own view.

  • Follow the dialogue at branch level and across the paritariste ecosystem and turn that understanding into internal clarity.

  • Be a sharp, early internal voice on where social dialogue is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy.

Build & Scale

  • Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on social partner positions, branch agreements, and paritariste institutions shared with Enterprise and Public Sector deal teams to increase win rates.

  • Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our social partner engagement and documentation.

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🧩 Context of the role

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

  • Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan

  • Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

  • Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).

🎯 Your mission

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include:

  • Business Strategy

    • Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan

    • Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC)

    • Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

  • Sales & Account Manager Planning

    • Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives, ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy

    • Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team

  • Performance monitoring & Steering

    • Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions

    • Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis

    • Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)

🧐 Skills we are looking for

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.

At least 3 years of experience within either:

  • Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

  • Management consulting, investment banking or private equity

Critical thinking and problem solving skills:

  • Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

  • Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

  • Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

  • Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company

Business sense:

  • At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

  • Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones

Communication and presence:

  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

  • Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

  • Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility

  • Great written and oral structure and communication

  • Fluency in English (French is a strong plus)

  • Being based in (or willing to relocate to) the Paris or Barcelona area

Nice to have

  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau) and Salesforce

  • Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors

  • Exposure to large sales teams (100+)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or Barcelona office

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Pourquoi participer ?

  • Viens vivre une expérience unique & décroche ta place parmi la nouvelle génération de Sales leaders chez Alan : un véritable tremplin pour accélérer ta carrière dans un environnement en hyper-croissance.

  • Découvre l'univers d'Alan : découvre notre mission et notre vision au contact direct de notre leadership et de nos équipes commerciales.

  • Bénéficie d'un process rapide & transparent : avec une réponse sous 48h à l'issue de la journée.

  • Plonge au cœur du métier d'Account Executive chez Alan : à travers des études de cas et des échanges privilégiés avec l'équipe.

Infos pratiques

  • 📅 Date de l'événement : Jeudi 1er octobre 2026, de 8h30 à 17h

  • 📍 Lieu : Now Coworking - Quai des Chartrons Hangar 15, 33000 Bordeaux

  • ⏰ Date limite de candidature : Jeudi 24 septembre 2026

  • 📈 Les étapes :

    • Nous examinons toutes les candidatures.

    • Si ton profil est retenu, nous t'appellerons pour échanger brièvement sur tes motivations.

    • Tu recevras un cas pratique à réaliser depuis chez toi.

    • Les candidat(e)s retenu(e)s seront invité(e)s à participer à notre journée exclusive, avec au programme des études de cas et des entretiens.

    • Nous donnons notre réponse sous 48h, et les candidat(e)s sélectionné(e)s rejoindront l'aventure Alan !

⭐️ Tout savoir sur le rôle d'Account Executive chez Alan

Ta mission en tant qu'Account Executive

Accompagner les prospects à chaque étape du cycle de vente et les transformer en clients Alan convaincus, en collaborant avec des décideurs de haut niveau : DRH, DAF et dirigeants, tous secteurs confondus.

Ce dont tu seras responsable

  • Cycle de vente complet de la prospection à la signature

  • Relations stratégiques : piloter les deals et gérer les relations clients clés

  • Réaliser des démonstrations produit inspirantes et guider les parties prenantes dans le processus d'évaluation

Important : Nous recrutons des Account Executives pour l’ensemble de nos équipes. Que ce soit dans le secteur du Retail, de l'Agroalimentaire, de la Métallurgie, des Services ou autres, nous ferons en sorte que tu rejoignes l’équipe dans laquelle tu t’épanouiras le plus et auras le plus d’impact 🌟

La méthode de vente Alan

Nous avons développé la méthode de vente smart & soft d'Alan.

Au-delà de la vente

En tant que membre de l'équipe Alan, tu pourras :

  • Participer à l'évolution de notre produit

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de nos méthodes et de notre stratégie

  • Participer aux initiatives de croissance

  • Faire partie d'une équipe qui innove constamment

Envie d'en savoir plus sur ce qui rend l’expérience exceptionnelle chez Alan ?

👉 Ecoute le parcours de Lucie Leflour, Head of Sales chez Alan.

👉 Ecoute le témoignage de Fanny Cibot, Account Executive depuis 5 ans à travers plusieurs équipes.

🎯 Ce rôle est-il fait pour toi ?

Chez Alan, notre devise est "nous recrutons des personnes, pas des rôles" : nous valorisons les compétences interpersonnelles autant que techniques. Nous croyons que ton potentiel est ce qui compte vraiment.

Tu seras un excellent fit pour rejoindre l'équipe si :

  • Tu as au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la gestion du cycle de vente complet

  • Tu maîtrises parfaitement le français (C2 et plus), et tu as un niveau avancé en anglais

  • Tu es très organisé(e), structuré(e) et empathique

  • Tu as la capacité à influencer, négocier et gérer des deals complexes

We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Join us as a Staff Data Analyst - Compliance to build the analytics foundations that power Qonto's compliance execution. You'll own a brand-new scope — monitoring KYC/KYB funnels, remediation campaigns, and financial exposure — working cross-functionally with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control, under the guidance of Alma, our Lead Data Analyst.

👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As a Data Analyst at Qonto, you will

  • Build compliance process monitoring from scratch: You'll build and own the data infrastructure that powers compliance monitoring at Qonto — from onboarding funnel analytics to remediation financial exposure — giving product, operations and compliance teams the self-service tools they need to make decisions without waiting on a data request.
  • Model and transform data with dbt: With the collaboration of Analytics Engineer Team, you'll build end-to-end transformation pipelines from source to consumption layer, keeping metric definitions clean and trusted by non-technical stakeholders.
  • Turn regulatory questions into self-service assets: You'll partner with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control to scope and ship analytical tools
  • Own the KYC/KYB funnel analytics end-to-end: You'll deliver insights from CS initiation through KYB validation — refusal reasons, document gaps, lead-time distributions — so teams can act on friction fast.
  • Track remediation campaigns and financial exposure: You'll measure MRR secured, at risk, or lost across active campaigns, with peak intensity in Q4 (budget season) and May–June (reforecast).

🤔 What you can expect

  • A greenfield, strategically critical scope: Qonto is under close regulatory scrutiny — you'll build analytics foundations that matter company-wide, not just for your team.
  • Senior, cross-functional exposure from day one: Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, Internal Control — few DA roles give you this breadth of senior stakeholder access at this level.
  • Real ownership in the Modern Data Stack: You'll build in Omni and dbt with a high degree of autonomy — no legacy to untangle, just foundations to create.
  • A team where AI is a first-class tool: Unlimited access to AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to evolve how you work, not just output more.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Alma, our Lead Data Analyst for Ops & Finance. Alma knows exactly what it takes to build an analytics function that actually changes decisions, and she'll push you to do the same.

Alma reports to Erwan, Director of Business Analytics who oversees the entire Analytics function and ensures alignment across teams.

🏅 About You

  • Compliance or regulated environment experience: You've worked analytically on KYC/KYB, AML, remediation, or similar regulatory/operational processes — and you know how to get credible with those stakeholders fast.
  • Self-service product mindset: You've designed dashboards and models for end-users to explore autonomously, adapting the same dataset from ops-level (daily SLA tracking) to exec-level (budget readouts).
  • Cross-functional stakeholder management: You've juggled competing analytical priorities across multiple teams — and you know how to scope clearly, push back when needed, and drive adoption.
  • Strong SQL and data modelling skills: You've built end-to-end transformation pipelines, enforced data quality, and made non-technical stakeholders trust your numbers.
  • AI-native workflow: You actively use AI tools to accelerate your analytics work — from data modelling to stakeholder communication — and you're genuinely curious about going further.
  • Language: Fluent in English.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (Storage) - remote friendly
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Qonto
description_html:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Join us as a Site Reliability Engineer on our Storage team to keep the databases Qonto runs on resilient, safe, and always available. You'll operate and improve our banking-grade storage infrastructure — PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka and Elasticsearch — and help make it self-serve for backend teams, under the guidance of Damien, our Storage Engineering Manager.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Operate and safeguard critical storage infrastructure: You'll run PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka and Elasticsearch in production, keeping banking-grade data safe and available.
  • Own incident response and root-cause analysis: You'll be the last line of defense when a hard query or performance problem needs solving.
  • Build our banking-license compliance roadmap: You'll define and prioritize backup and disaster-recovery scenarios with our Risk & Compliance team.
  • Ship code for our internal platform APIs: You'll build self-service tooling that lets backend teams spin up storage resources in minutes, not days.
  • Help shape how AI agents access sensitive systems: You'll contribute to making our storage APIs safe and traceable for autonomous agents, not just humans.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Solid PostgreSQL production experience: You've operated PostgreSQL in production and know how to investigate performance issues, reason about backups/restores, and make safe changes. Deep mastery is a strong plus, but we don't expect you to be a dedicated PostgreSQL expert from day one.
  • Comfortable across the storage stack: You have working knowledge of Redis, Kafka or Elasticsearch, and you pick up new systems fast.
  • Practical AI usage in your daily workflow: You already use AI to speed up debugging, coding, documentation or operational work — not as a buzzword, but as a real productivity habit. You're also curious about how AI agents can safely and traceably interact with sensitive production systems.
  • You write code: You're comfortable shipping features, not just scripts, for the internal platform tools your team builds.
  • Calm, rigorous incident response: You've handled production incidents on stateful systems and stay composed when the pressure is on.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A team about to raise the bar on resilience: With Qonto's banking-license roadmap underway, you'll help define how a regulated fintech operates its data.
  • Real ownership from day one: You'll drive your own reliability and disaster-recovery roadmap, not just execute someone else's backlog.
  • A growing team: Storage is scaling toward 5-6 engineers, so there's real room to shape how the team works, not just join it.
  • A fully remote-first team: Your teammates are spread across Europe.

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Damien Cupif, our Storage Engineering Manager — but don't expect micro-management. Damien started out as a data engineer and naturally pivoted into infrastructure after building the tooling his own data pipelines needed. He sets a clear direction, stays hands-on with his team, and is genuinely invested in how each new hire ramps up and grows.

If this sounds like you — even if you don't check every box — we'd love to hear from you.

At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

🔒 Your security matters to us

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.

title: On Holiday Support Agent
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at loveholidays
description_html:
Why loveholidays?

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

Here, we're doing things differently to open the world to everyone, and our Customer Experience team is at the forefront of driving cutting-edge innovation. Join our fast-growing business where your ideas are heard and new thinking shapes how millions book their holidays.

You'll accelerate your growth in our fast-paced environment, tackling daily challenges and learning from inspiring leaders and teammates. Be empowered to create impact for our future by shaping the most-loved package holiday experience for millions. As we pursue ambitious plans to expand across Europe, you'll be part of a fun-loving international community achieving great things together.

About the team:

The On Holiday Support team helps customers resolve issues that arise while they are away. This can include transfer problems, accommodation concerns, supplier issues, flight disruption and other unexpected situations that may affect a customer’s holiday.

Customers may contact us when they are tired, worried, frustrated or unsure what to do next. Our role is to listen, understand what has happened and take ownership of finding the most appropriate resolution.

You will be part of the UK On Holiday Support team and report to an On Holiday Support Team Leader. You will also work closely with colleagues in our offshore partner team and with suppliers and internal departments across loveholidays..

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. We welcome applications from candidates based in London and the surrounding areas. As this role requires some attendance at our London office, applications from candidates with a commute of more than 2 hours each way will not be considered.

The impact you’ll have:

You’ll support customers at moments when the service we provide can have a real impact on their holiday, taking ownership and responding with empathy, urgency and sound judgement.

This means investigating what’s happened, communicating clearly and working towards practical resolutions. Some cases will be straightforward, while others may require supplier contact, further investigation or escalation to specialist teams.

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. A customer-first mindset and strong problem-solving skills are essential, particularly when handling more challenging cases and helping restore customers’ confidence in loveholidays. You’ll also support English-speaking customers across our international markets.

High performers may have opportunities to develop into specialist areas, including wellbeing and safeguarding.

Your day-to-day:

  • Support customers through telephone, chat and case-based contact while they are on holiday

  • Listen carefully, understand the customer’s circumstances and identify the most appropriate next steps

  • Take ownership of customer issues and work towards a resolution wherever possible

  • Use good judgement to balance customer needs, urgency, safety, policy and commercial considerations

  • Contact hotels, transfer providers, airlines and other suppliers to investigate issues and agree solutions

  • Make outbound calls when speaking directly with a customer or supplier is the quickest and most effective way to resolve an issue

  • Keep customers updated and set clear expectations throughout their case

  • Recognise risk and escalate safeguarding, wellbeing or major incident concerns through the correct process

  • Maintain clear, accurate and complete case notes

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues in the UK, our offshore partner and other loveholidays teams

  • Identify recurring customer or supplier issues and provide feedback so that the underlying cause can be addressed

  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of relevant processes, policies, systems and travel-industry developments

Your skillset:

  • Strong and demonstrable customer-service skills

  • A calm, empathetic and professional communication style

  • Confidence speaking with customers who may be upset, frustrated or under pressure

  • Strong ownership and a willingness to see issues through to resolution

  • Sound judgement and the confidence to make decisions within agreed guidelines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail

  • Emotional resilience and the ability to work effectively with sensitive or challenging customer situations

  • A collaborative approach and confidence working with colleagues from different teams and cultures

The interview journey:

  1. Intro to a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 20 minutes

  2. Interview and assessment with the Hiring Manager and Team Leader – 60 minutes

Perks of joining us:

Other than an amazing environment for you to grow, have impact and show the world your incredible skills, we offer the following benefits:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. Each individual offers unique perspectives and ideas that increase the diversity and effectiveness of our teams. And we value the insight and potential you could bring on our continued journey.

title: Senior Security Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at CENTREON
description_html:
Centreon cherche à renforcer l'équipe sécurité en intégrant un senior security engineer. Au cœur du produit Centreon, la team security a un impact fort. Elle joue un rôle central au sein de la R&D composée d’environ 50 tech. Elle collabore notamment étroitement avec les équipes  infra cloud et software engineers.

Pluridisciplinaire, vous intégrez une équipe composée de 2 personnes au profils riches et variés. Vous êtes expert sur la partie Cloud et notamment AWS. Vous accompagnerez l’ensemble de la tech (dev, product, SRE) pour apporter les best practices, construire la plateforme, automatiser  les process, déployer des composants, opérer des solutions etc 

Vos missions seront diverses et  toujours guidées par l’envie de partager les succès mais avec un ownership fort.

Missions : 

  • Intégrer les pratiques de sécurité dans le cycle complet de notre infrastructure et de notre plateforme cloud en interne ainsi que dans nos produits SaaS.

  • Contribuer au développement d'une architecture de sécurité robuste qui s'aligne sur le modèle zéro trust.

  • Renforcer la sécurité du cloud (AWS, on-prem), participer au hardening de l’infra, à la protection contre les menaces avancées et à la conception de SaaS sécurisés.

  • Participer activement à une équipe d'ingénieurs diversifiée composée d'ingénieurs en sécurité, d'ingénieurs logiciels, de devops et de SRE.

  • Construire et opérer la stratégie de sécurisation des usages et technologies d'IA au sein de l'entreprise;

  • Garantir la maintenabilité et l'évolutivité des différents composants, en diffusant les best practices de sécurité à l'état de l'art ;

  • Collaborer avec les software engineers, l'équipe infra et le produit pour construire des produits et des services secure by design ;

  • Construire une stratégie de réponse aux incidents efficace et solide à l’aide de systèmes d'alerting  et de détection modernes ; corriger et mitiger les problèmes de sécurité en collaboration avec l'équipe Infra..

  • Faire évoluer les capacités de l'équipe sécurité en s'appuyant sur l'IA agentique pour automatiser le traitement des tâches répétitives (alertes, triage, reporting)

  • Être un membre actif de la guilde de sécurité

  • Bug Bounty management

Stack technique : AWS – Terraform – Zero trust : Okta, Teleport  - SSLDC - SIEM 


Profil et compétences 

  • Vous êtes autonome et faites preuve d’ownership, êtes capable de leader des projet transverses

  • Vous avez une expérience significative en sécurité des infra cloud : système, réseau et notamment AWS.

  • Vous avez une bonne compréhension de la sécurité dans les systèmes distribués à l'échelle..

  • Vous avez une bonne connaissance de la gestion de l'IAM sur les fournisseurs de cloud (AWS, Auth0).

  • Vous maîtrisez un ou plusieurs langages de notre stack tech.

  • Vous avez un intérêt pour l'écosystème OpenSource et pour le monitoring.

  • Vous aimez innover et faire évoluer les architectures des plateformes vers une plus grande scalabilité.

  • Vous voulez être un membre actif d'une équipe d'ingénieurs diversifiée composée d'ingénieurs en sécurité, d'ingénieurs logiciels, de devops et de SRE.


Les plus qui feront la différence :

  • Vous avez des compétences ou expériences et intérêt pour la sécurité corporate IT  (SSO/IAM, EDR, MDM...)

  • Vous êtes sensible à la culture de l’open-source 

  • Vous êtes sensible à l’expérience utilisateur (performance, ergonomie, utilisabilité, etc.) 

  • Vous aimez défier vos collègues au babyfoot ! 

Ce que nous offrons

  • Société en forte croissance (+20%  en 2025) dans un environnement international

  • Venez apprécier nos locaux à Paris avec terrasse à Olympiade - Métro ligne 14 ou à Toulouse quartier Compans Caffarelli (immeubles accessibles PMR)

  • RTT et Carte Tickets restaurant

  • Events mensuels et semestriels

  • Petits dej mensuels

  • Un programme d'Onboarding

  • Pleins d'autres avantages --> https://centreon.recruitee.com/qui-sommes-nous

Nous avons à cœur de mettre en avant la diversité au sein de notre entreprise. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront pris en considération pour un emploi sans distinction de race, de couleur, de religion, de sexe, d'orientation sexuelle, d'identité de genre, de nationalité ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi dans le pays où le candidat postule.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

title: Product Guide (Sales Associate) Saisonnier – CDD 35H (h/f/d) – La Vallée Village
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at ARC'TERYX
description_html:
Votre opportunité chez ARC’TERYX :
 
Nous recherchons des Vendeurs / Vendeuses CDD pour rejoindre notre magasin !
 
Vous incarnez la marque en magasin et offrez une expérience inoubliable à nos clients. Vous êtes la source d’inspiration de l’évolution de notre marque, qui poursuit son engagement envers des objectifs ambitieux, en magasin comme au sein de nos communautés.
 
Vous êtes passionné(e) par les produits et recherchez la moindre occasion de sortir pour expérimenter et découvrir par vous-même leurs performances. Vous privilégiez votre lien avec la nature et encouragez les autres à faire de même. Vous partagez avec authenticité vos connaissances sur les produits avec vos clients et recommandez des produits en fonction de leurs centres d’intérêt et de leurs besoins.
 
Vous privilégiez votre développement personnel et professionnel, et vous célébrez les réussites des autres. Vous êtes convaincu(e) que nous créons un monde meilleur, ensemble.

En tant que Conseiller de vente chez Arc’teryx, voici ce que vous ferez :
  • Créer des expériences client mémorables : Vous apportez énergie et expertise à chaque interaction : en partageant vos connaissances produits, en résolvant les problèmes et en aidant les clients à trouver l’équipement qui correspond à leur besoin et à leur passion.
  • Incarner la marque, en magasin comme à l’extérieur : Véritable ambassadeur·trice Arc’teryx, vous représentez nos valeurs aussi bien en magasin qu’au sein de la communauté. Vous restez curieux·se, continuez d’apprendre et inspirez les autres à se connecter avec la nature.
  • Grandir et Collaborer : Vous développez vos compétences avec le soutien de votre équipe, contribuez aux initiatives de la marque et améliorez l’expérience en magasin grâce à vos retours et à votre collaboration.
  • Assurer le bon fonctionnement du magasin : Du traitement des transactions et de la gestion, des attentes des clients au déballage des stocks et au soutien des tâches quotidiennes : vous veillez à ce que tout se déroule sans accroc.


    • La vie dans nos magasins

    Vous ferez partie d’une équipe qui aime passer du temps dehors ensemble, partager ses connaissances produits, créer des relations solides avec nos clients et accorder une attention particulière aux détails. Le travail est concret, réfléchi et profondément ancré dans la connexion à la nature et avec la communauté.


    Êtes-vous notre prochain Product Guide ?
  • Culture de l’Expérience Client : Une passion pour offrir des expériences client exceptionnelles et renforcer la fidélité à la marque grâce au service, au storytelling et à l’engagement communautaire.
  • Assumer son impact : Vous prenez vos responsabilités, restez autonome et motivé(e), et aimez résoudre les problèmes. Vous recherchez des solutions intelligentes, même lorsqu’elles ne sont pas les plus simples.
  • Challenger le statu quo :  Vous remettez en question le statu quo, inspirez de nouvelles idées et adoptez une amélioration continue — pour vous-même comme pour ceux qui vous entourent.
  • Compétences linguistiques : Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais indispensable.
  • Flexibilité : Disponibilité lors des temps forts du retail (ex. Black Friday, fêtes de fin d’année…) et capacité à soulever jusqu’à 15kgs si nécessaire.
    • Détails:
     
    Horaires :
    à temps plein – 35 heures par semaine (5 jours par semaine)
     
    Contrat :
    CDD (Octobre 2026 - Janvier 2027)
     
    Rémunération:
    Salaire fixe + Bonus
     
     

    Évolution chez Arc’teryx :

    Chez Arc’teryx, la progression se construit grâce à la pratique, au feedback et au soutien d’une communauté élargie. À mesure que nous ouvrons de nouveaux magasins dans la région, de nouvelles opportunités émergent pour les collaborateurs qui souhaitent développer leurs compétences et assumer davantage de responsabilités.

    Ce que nous valorisons dans nos équipes :
    Nos magasins rassemblent des collaborateurs issus de cultures, de langues et de parcours variés. Cette diversité enrichit notre manière d’apprendre les uns des autres et offre une expérience exceptionnelle à nos clients.

    Notre approche du recrutement :
    Nous privilégions un processus de recrutement simple, humain et réfléchi. Chaque candidature est examinée avec attention, et nous vous contacterons si votre profil correspond à ce que nous recherchons.

    Avantages & Bénéfices :

    • LIVE IT : Du temps et de l’espace pour se reconnecter à la nature et mener une vie pleine de sens
    • Soutien à la planification : Des plannings prévisibles qui favorisent l’équilibre au sein de l’équipe
    • Arc’ Adventure : Un programme de reconnaissance offrant des expériences outdoor à travers l’Europe
    • Croissance & Apprentissage : Accès à des formations en leadership, ateliers de développement de compétences et programmes d’évolution professionnelle
    • Ressources Bien‑Être : Des dispositifs de soutien pour favoriser le bien‑être physique, mental et financier
    • Accès au matériel : Programme d’achat collaborateur avantageux + offres professionnelles du secteur
    • Care & Repair : Accès à des conseils d’entretien et à des services de réparation en accord avec notre engagement ReBIRD

    *Les avantages peuvent varier selon le poste et la localisation.


    Equal Opportunity
     
    Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance. 
     
    Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities where we operate.  
     
    All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.

    Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world.

    Disruptive evolution. In pursuit of better. Always.

title: Stage de 6 mois UX/UI Designer (H/F/N) – PARIS
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Ekimetrics
description_html:
Les entreprises qui performent décident mieux. Depuis 2006, Ekimetrics aide les organisations à transformer leurs décisions en avantage concurrentiel durable grâce à des solutions d’IA. Notre double ambition est d’allier performance et durabilité, pour construire un leadership pérenne.

Nos solutions sont une combinaison unique de People et de technologie. Notre plateforme Eki.Decisions complète l’expertise de nos équipes en marketing, efficacité commerciale et data science, pour connecter l’IA aux décisions qui structurent toute l’organisation.

Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un avantage concurrentiel constant, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.

Vous rejoignez l'équipe produit 

Si vous êtes passionné·e par le design, que vous aimez transformer une donnée complexe en visuel et que vous voulez apprendre à concevoir des interfaces au service de vrais enjeux data, votre place est sûrement chez Ekimetrics. 

Ekimetrics est leader en data science et fournisseur de solutions AI. Depuis plus de 20 ans, nous utilisons la data science au service de l’optimisation de performance marketing, business et de la transition vers une performance plus durable. 

Si vous êtes passionné·e par le design d’interfaces élégantes et intuitives, que vous aimez transformer des idées en prototypes concrets et que vous rêvez d’expérimenter avec l’IA, votre place est sûrement chez Ekimetrics ! 

Pourquoi recrutons nous ? 

L'équipe Produit conçoit des solutions data-driven et logiciels métier, centrées sur l'utilisateur, qui aident nos clients à prendre de meilleures décisions business à partir de leurs données.  

Design, data science et développement travaillent main dans la main sur des problèmes concrets.  

Elle compte 30 personnes (full-stack developers, Product managers, Product owners, DevOps et Product designers) qui construisent les plateformes de data science et d'IA que nos clients utilisent au quotidien pour piloter leurs décisions. 

Pour accélérer la production de ces interfaces, améliorer les parcours de nos utilisateurs et recueillir leurs retours, nous recrutons un·e stagiaire UX/UI Designer, suivi·e par un product designer senior, avec une vraie autonomie sur des projets complets menés en s'appuyant sur le design system Ekimetrics, les méthodes agiles et selon la méthode du double diamant.  

Le process de recrutement :

  • Un entretien RH, 
  • Un entretien technique sur site 
  • Un entretien final.
Est attendu un portfolio démontrant d'au moins 3 projets variés ainsi qu'une expertise Figma et UI avancés 

Vos missions : 

  • Concevoir des flows, wireframes et maquettes : pas des écrans isolés, mais des parcours qui aident nos clients à décider. 

  • Contribuer au design system : comprendre pourquoi une règle existe avant de l'appliquer, puis la faire évoluer sans casser la cohérence entre nos produits. 

  • Participer aux ateliers UX et aux tests d'utilisabilité (Maze), et proposer des solutions argumentées. 

  • Travailler avec les product designers, les product owners et les développeurs. 

Profil recherché :  

  • Bac+5 en cours, en design, UX/UI ou multimédia interactif. 

  • Vous suivez les nouveaux produits et les tendances (design systems, IA appliquée au produit, nouvelles interactions), et vous voulez comprendre pourquoi ils fonctionnent. 

  • Vous maîtrisez Figma en profondeur (variables, auto-layout, composants). 

  • Pour vous, un design system est un système de règles, pas une bibliothèque de composants. Une connaissance de shadcn/ui ou d'un système équivalent est un plus. 

  • Vous défendez vos choix avec des arguments, pas seulement avec du goût. 

  • Vous gérez seul·e votre temps et vos priorités. 

  • Vous êtes proactif·ve et fiable sur les deadlines : vous partagez idées, doutes et avancement réel sans attendre qu'on vous le demande. 

Les petits plus : 

  • Des connaissances en accessibilité web seront appréciées
  • Des compétences à restituer en vidéo et sous forme de slides 

Modalités :  

  • Stage de 6 mois, démarrage prévu entre janvier et mars 2027. 

  • Software : Jira, Figma et Maze. 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent: à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif.  

Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.  

Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même. 

En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.  

Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 ! Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.   

Vous aurez accès :  

  • Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School. 

  • A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People ; 

  • De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté ;  

  • Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards) 

  • Une politique de télétravail flexible, avec 3 jours de présence obligatoire par tranche de 15 jours.  

En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ekimetrics veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité dans ses équipes.

title: Senior Strategic Consultant Professional Services
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Contentsquare
description_html:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
 
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
 
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
 
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

About the job

The Professional Services team helps Contentsquare customers turn digital experience data into measurable business outcomes. As a Senior Strategic Consultant, you will be a senior, client-facing consultant responsible for delivering strategic, analytical, and enablement services to enterprise customers. You will combine consulting expertise, project management, digital analytics knowledge, and Contentsquare expertise to help customers understand their digital experience, prioritize opportunities, and take action.

You will work across two types of engagements:

 

  1. One-off consulting missions, where you lead and deliver a defined project (analysis, workshop, training..)

  2. Managed-services engagements, where you act as the delivery owner and project manager for an ongoing customer relationship. You will manage the service roadmap, coordinate contributors, maintain delivery momentum, and proactively ensure that the customer receives value from the available services.

You will operate as a trusted advisor to customer teams, including operational stakeholders, analytics teams, technical teams, and senior or economic buyers. You will work closely with Customer Success Manager and Sales but also all your Professional Services colleagues such as Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants..

This role is ideal for someone who combines the structure and client leadership of a senior consultant with the curiosity and practical fluency of a digital analytics power user.




What you’ll do

  • Own the delivery of strategic consulting and analytics engagements from discovery through completion.

  • Act as the primary operational point of contact for the services being delivered to the customer.

  • Define project objectives, scope, milestones, working methods, deliverables, and success criteria.

  • Build and manage delivery plans, priorities, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.

  • Lead managed-services engagements as the delivery owner and project manager.

  • Maintain a proactive service roadmap and identify the right missions, workshops, analyses, training sessions, and enablement activities for each customer.

  • Coordinate the work of Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants, and other specialists when required.

  • Escalate delivery risks, scope issues, capacity constraints, or customer blockers in a timely manner.

  • Ensure that customers receive measurable value from their Professional Services engagement.

  • Apply digital analytics and Contentsquare expertise

  • Analyze digital experience data and translate findings into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.

  • Prepare and deliver analyses, executive readouts, workshops, training sessions, and working sessions with customer teams.

  • Help customers define use cases, measurement approaches, prioritization frameworks, and roadmaps.
  • Assess data collection, tagging plans, data quality, measurement frameworks, and the conditions required for reliable analysis.
  • Use Contentsquare and other digital analytics tools to investigate customer questions and support evidence-based decisions.
  • Understand how digital analytics data can connect with broader customer data ecosystems, including business intelligence tools, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and activation platforms.
  • You are not expected to be a specialist Data Analyst or Data Architect, but you should be comfortable working with data and explaining analytical findings to both business and technical stakeholders.
    •  

    Partner with customers and internal teams

  • Facilitate discussions with operational teams, analytics teams, technical stakeholders, senior leaders, and economic buyers.

  • Work closely with the Customer Success Manager. The CSM owns the broader partnership, while you own the quality, coordination, and delivery of the services provided.

  • Collaborate across the broader Professional Services organization and contribute your expertise to team discussions, methods, and delivery standards.

  • Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and become a reliable advisor on their digital experience and analytics priorities.

  • Communicate complex analytical or technical concepts clearly to audiences with different levels of expertise.

    •  

    Identify risks and opportunities

  • Monitor customer adoption, engagement, delivery progress, and stakeholder participation.

  • Proactively identify risks such as declining adoption, missed milestones, unclear ownership, or limited use of the platform.

  • Surface relevant expansion or cross-sell opportunities to the Customer Success and Sales teams. This is not a quota-carrying sales role, but you are expected to recognize when additional Contentsquare capabilities or services could address a customer need.

  • Identify opportunities to improve customer processes, measurement practices, data flows, or use of digital analytics.

    • Improve how we work

  • Contribute to reusable consulting methods, frameworks, templates, and points of view.

  • Use artificial intelligence responsibly to improve preparation, analysis, delivery quality, and internal processes.

  • Stay current with developments in digital analytics, artificial intelligence, data ecosystems, and customer experience measurement.

  • Share knowledge with other consultants and help strengthen the capabilities of the wider Professional Services team.

    •  

    What you’ll need to succeed

  • Approximately 5 to 6 years of experience in management consulting, strategic consulting, digital consulting, professional services, or a similar customer-facing advisory environment.

  • Experience working with large enterprise customers and navigating complex stakeholder environments.

  • Demonstrated experience managing projects or workstreams from discovery through delivery.

  • Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, including the ability to lead workshops and executive discussions.

  • Structured thinking and strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame ambiguous customer challenges clearly.

  • Practical experience with digital analytics, business intelligence, conversion optimization, customer experience analytics, or related data products.

  • Familiarity with digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics. Experience with Contentsquare is highly valuable.

  • Understanding of tagging plans, data collection, data quality, measurement frameworks, data structures, and the limitations that can affect analytical outcomes.

  • Ability to interpret data, develop an analysis, and communicate the implications and recommendations clearly.

  • Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Strong project management skills, including planning, prioritization, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and escalation.

  • Ability to work independently across a changing mix of one-off missions and recurring managed-services engagements.

  • Comfortable collaborating with Customer Success, Sales, Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, and other specialist teams.

  • Practical curiosity about artificial intelligence, data flows, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and modern digital analytics ecosystems.

  • Ability to use AI tools thoughtfully to improve your own work and customer delivery, while applying appropriate judgment and maintaining confidentiality.

  • Full professional fluency in French and English, including the ability to lead customer conversations, workshops, and presentations in French.

  • Availability to work with customers primarily during French or Central European business hours.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for customer engagements, team meetings, and company events.

    • Why you should join Contentsquare
    We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.
     
    Here are a few we want to highlight:
    - Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year
    - Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies
    - Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)
    - Lifestyle allowance
    - A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work
    - Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success
    - We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts
    - And more benefits tailored to each country
     
    Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
     
    Your personal data is used by Contentsquare for recruitment purposes only. Read our Job Candidate Privacy Notice to find out more about data protection at Contentsquare and your rights. You can exercise your rights by using our dedicated Data Subject Rights Portal here. 
     
    Your personal data will be securely stored in our hosting provider’s data center in Oregon (US west). We have implemented appropriate transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws.
     
    Contentsquare may use AI-assisted tools to help review and screen applications. All decisions involving hiring are made by human reviewers, and your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

title: Account Development Representative - France
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Samsara
description_html:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from Germany, France and the United Kingdom.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and LinkedIn
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Ingénieure ou Ingénieur réseau et salle serveur  - CDI
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Institut Mines-Télécom
description_html:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 5 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons notre futur(e) Ingénieur(e) réseau et salle serveur pour rejoindre le pôle Systèmes, Réseaux et Infrastructure de la DSI.

Vos missions principales seront les suivantes :

  • Assurer le bon fonctionnement et les évolutions des réseaux gérés par l’école.

  • Contribuer au support aux usagers sur les problématiques liées au réseau.
